_nguon: EN-ALL GĐ 6 — bản phủ tiếng Anh của lời kinh Chu Dịch: quái từ, Đại tượng, Thoán truyện, 384 hào (+ Dụng Cửu / Dụng Lục). Nguyên văn Hán giữ nguyên (không phủ 'han'). Bản dịch Anh do ban biên tập dịch từ nguyên văn Hán (editorial translation), đối chiếu cách hiểu của các bản dịch tiếng Anh thông dụng; 'y' (ý) và 'nom_na' (In plain terms) là lời giải thích của ban biên tập — không dịch từ bản Việt của Ngô Tất Tố. Chờ người bản xứ duyệt.

que_tu.dich: The Creative: sublime success, furthering through perseverance.

dai_tuong.dich: Heaven moves with strength; the noble person makes themselves strong without ceasing.

1.nom_na: Image: heaven upon heaven — strength following strength without pause. In plain terms: like someone with real inner power who wants to do something big: it can be done, but each stage has its own way of moving — do not charge ahead all the time.

thoan.dich: Great indeed is the originating power of the Creative! All things owe their beginning to it, and it governs heaven. Clouds move and rain falls, and all things take form. Seeing clearly the end and the beginning, the six positions are completed in time; riding the six dragons it governs the sky. The way of the Creative changes and transforms, so that each thing finds its true nature and destiny, preserving great harmony — this is what furthers through perseverance. It towers above all things, and all lands are at peace.

hao.dich: Hidden dragon. Do not act.
hao.y: The time is not yet ripe; build up your strength quietly.
hao.nom_na: Like a talented newcomer: learn and prepare first, do not show off yet.

hao.dich: Dragon appearing in the field. It furthers one to see the great person.
hao.y: Your ability starts to show; find someone who can guide you.
hao.nom_na: Like being noticed at work for the first time: a good moment to find a mentor.

hao.dich: The noble person is busy all day, and watchful at night. Danger, but no blame.
hao.y: Work hard and stay alert; that keeps you out of trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like someone with a lot of responsibility: busy all day, and checking things over in the evening — tiring, but safe.

hao.dich: Perhaps leaping up, perhaps staying in the deep. No blame.
hao.y: A turning point: you can leap or wait — choose freely, without blame.
hao.nom_na: Like standing at the edge of a big decision: you may jump or hold back, either is fine if you have thought it through.

hao.dich: Flying dragon in the heavens. It furthers one to see the great person.
hao.y: You are at your height; work with people of real stature.
hao.nom_na: Like a leader at the peak of their powers: the moment to act, alongside capable people.

hao.dich: Arrogant dragon will have cause to repent.
hao.y: Going too far brings regret; know when to stop.
hao.nom_na: Like someone who keeps pushing after reaching the top: the higher they go, the harder the fall.

dung.dich: All lines nine: a flight of dragons without a head. Good fortune.
dung.y: Strength that does not insist on leading brings good fortune.
dung.nom_na: Like a team of strong people where no one needs to be the boss: things go well.

que_tu.dich: The Receptive: sublime success, furthering through the perseverance of a mare. The noble person has somewhere to go: leading, they go astray; following, they find guidance. It furthers to find friends in the south-west and to lose friends in the north-east. Quiet perseverance brings good fortune.

dai_tuong.dich: The earth's condition is receptive devotion; the noble person, with broad virtue, carries the outer world.

2.nom_na: Image: earth upon earth — wide, soft, carrying all things. In plain terms: this is a time for the supporting role: follow, lay the groundwork; steadiness and generosity get further than fighting to be first.

thoan.dich: Perfect indeed is the originating power of the Receptive! All things owe their birth to it, and it receives heaven with devotion. The Receptive in its breadth carries all things; its virtue joins with the limitless. Embracing and generous, bright and great, all kinds of beings flourish. The mare belongs to the earth and roams it without limit; gentle and devoted, it furthers through perseverance. When the noble person goes ahead to lead, they lose the way; when they follow with devotion, they find the constant path. Finding friends in the south-west means going with your own kind; losing friends in the north-east brings blessing in the end. The good fortune of quiet perseverance answers to the limitless earth.

hao.dich: When there is hoarfrost underfoot, solid ice is not far off.
hao.y: Small signs show where things are heading; act early.
hao.nom_na: Like the first unpaid bill or the first sharp word: small now, but it grows if you ignore it.

hao.dich: Straight, square, great. Without practice, nothing that does not further.
hao.y: Be upright and true to your nature, and things go well by themselves.
hao.nom_na: Like an honest person doing their job well: no tricks needed, things work out.

hao.dich: Hidden lines. One is able to remain persevering. If you are in the king's service, seek no credit, but carry the work to the end.
hao.y: Keep your talent quiet and see the work through without claiming credit.
hao.nom_na: Like a capable assistant: does the work well, lets others take the stage, and is valued in the end.

hao.dich: A tied-up sack. No blame, no praise.
hao.y: A time to be careful with your words and keep a low profile.
hao.nom_na: Like keeping your opinions to yourself in a tense meeting: no gain, but no trouble either.

hao.dich: A yellow lower garment brings supreme good fortune.
hao.y: Modest virtue in a high place brings the greatest good fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like a respected person who stays humble: everyone trusts them.

hao.dich: Dragons fight in the meadow. Their blood is black and yellow.
hao.y: Pushing too far leads to a clash where both sides get hurt.
hao.nom_na: Like a quarrel that keeps escalating: in the end both people are hurt.

dung.dich: All lines six: lasting perseverance furthers.
dung.y: Steady perseverance over the long run is what brings benefit.
dung.nom_na: Like someone who keeps going patiently year after year: it pays off.

que_tu.dich: Difficulty at the Beginning: sublime success, furthering through perseverance. Do not set out to go anywhere; it furthers to appoint helpers.

dai_tuong.dich: Clouds and thunder: the image of difficulty at the beginning; the noble person brings order out of confusion.

3.nom_na: Image: clouds and thunder churning but no rain yet — everything is just starting and still tangled. In plain terms: like opening a new shop or starting a new business: early hiccups are normal; you need helpers and to sort things out one by one, without trying to do everything.

thoan.dich: Difficulty at the beginning: the firm and the yielding first meet, and difficulties arise. Movement in the midst of danger brings great success through perseverance. The movement of thunder and rain fills everything; heaven creates things in chaos and darkness. It is right to appoint helpers, and not to rest.

hao.dich: Hesitation and hindrance. It furthers to remain persevering. It furthers to appoint helpers.
hao.y: Hold your ground at the start and gather people around you.
hao.nom_na: Like a project that cannot get going yet: stay put, keep it right, and find people to help.

hao.dich: Difficulties pile up. Horse and wagon part. Not a robber — he wants to woo when the time comes. The girl is chaste and does not pledge herself; after ten years she pledges herself.
hao.y: What looks like a threat may be an offer; but wait until the time is right.
hao.nom_na: Like an offer that comes too early: it is not bad, but it is not the moment — give it time.

hao.dich: Hunting deer without a forester, you only lose your way in the forest. The noble person sees the signs and prefers to give up; going on brings humiliation.
hao.y: Going ahead without guidance leads you astray; better to stop.
hao.nom_na: Like chasing a deal you do not understand without anyone to advise you: better to let it go.

hao.dich: Horse and wagon part. Seek union. Going brings good fortune; everything acts to further.
hao.y: Now is the time to reach out and join with others.
hao.nom_na: Like realising you cannot do it alone and asking for help: things start to move.

hao.dich: Difficulties in blessing. A little perseverance brings good fortune; great perseverance brings misfortune.
hao.y: Resources are tight; small steps work, big pushes do not.
hao.nom_na: Like having little money to work with: small, careful moves succeed, big gambles fail.

hao.dich: Horse and wagon part. Tears of blood flow.
hao.y: Stuck and despairing; it is time to find a new way.
hao.nom_na: Like being stuck for so long that you are worn out: stop and change direction.

que_tu.dich: Youthful Folly has success. It is not I who seek the young fool; the young fool seeks me. At the first consultation I give an answer. Asking two or three times is importunate, and then I give no answer. Perseverance furthers.

dai_tuong.dich: A spring wells up at the foot of the mountain: the image of youth; the noble person acts decisively and nurtures character.

4.nom_na: Image: a spring rising at the foot of the mountain — water that does not yet know where to flow. In plain terms: like a beginner who does not know the way yet: find the right teacher, ask sincerely once, and learn with discipline.

thoan.dich: Youthful folly: danger at the foot of the mountain; danger and standing still — that is folly. Youthful folly has success because it acts in success and hits the right time. It is not I who seek the young fool, the young fool seeks me — their will responds. At the first consultation I give an answer, because the teacher is firm and central. Asking two or three times is importunate, and the importunate get no answer — that is the folly of disrespect. To nurture what is right in the young is the work of the sage.

hao.dich: To make a fool develop, it furthers to apply discipline. Remove the fetters; going on in that way brings humiliation.
hao.y: Some discipline is needed at the start, but not too much for too long.
hao.nom_na: Like training someone new: set clear rules, but do not keep them in a straitjacket.

hao.dich: To bear with fools in kindliness brings good fortune. To take a wife brings good fortune. The son is capable of running the household.
hao.y: Patience and generosity with others bring good results.
hao.nom_na: Like a good older sibling who patiently helps the younger ones: the whole family benefits.

hao.dich: Do not take a maiden who, when she sees a man of wealth, loses possession of herself. Nothing furthers.
hao.y: Do not join with someone who loses themselves at the sight of money.
hao.nom_na: Like a partner who changes their mind as soon as a better offer appears: not someone to rely on.

hao.dich: Entangled folly brings humiliation.
hao.y: Stubbornly refusing to learn leaves you stuck.
hao.nom_na: Like someone who will not listen to anyone: they end up in a tight spot.

hao.dich: Childlike folly brings good fortune.
hao.y: An open, humble mind that is willing to learn brings good fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like a beginner who asks and listens: they learn fast.

hao.dich: In punishing folly it does not further one to commit transgressions. It furthers one to prevent transgressions.
hao.y: Correct mistakes firmly, but to protect, not to hurt.
hao.nom_na: Like a strict parent: the point is to keep the child out of harm, not to punish for its own sake.

que_tu.dich: Waiting. If you are sincere, you have light and success. Perseverance brings good fortune. It furthers to cross the great water.

dai_tuong.dich: Clouds rise up to heaven: the image of waiting; the noble person eats, drinks and is joyous and of good cheer.

5.nom_na: Image: clouds have risen into the sky but the rain has not fallen. In plain terms: like waiting for an answer or a result: it will come; meanwhile eat well, keep your strength and prepare — do not rush across the river while the water is still wild.

thoan.dich: Waiting means holding back; danger lies ahead. Being firm and strong, one does not fall into it, so the meaning is that one is not trapped. Waiting, with sincerity, has light and success; perseverance brings good fortune, for one holds the place of heaven, upright and central. It furthers to cross the great water: going forward brings achievement.

hao.dich: Waiting in the meadow. It furthers to abide in what endures. No blame.
hao.y: Danger is still far off; keep to your normal routine.
hao.nom_na: Like waiting for news that is still a long way off: carry on with daily life as usual.

hao.dich: Waiting on the sand. There is some small gossip. The end brings good fortune.
hao.y: A little friction while you wait, but it ends well.
hao.nom_na: Like waiting while people talk: some annoyance, but it works out.

hao.dich: Waiting in the mud brings about the arrival of the enemy.
hao.y: Waiting in a bad spot invites trouble; be careful.
hao.nom_na: Like stalling in a risky position: you make yourself an easy target.

hao.dich: Waiting in blood. Get out of the pit.
hao.y: You are in the thick of danger; find your way out calmly.
hao.nom_na: Like being caught in a crisis: stay calm and look for the exit.

hao.dich: Waiting at meat and wine. Perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Relax and enjoy what you have while you wait for the right time.
hao.nom_na: Like taking time to rest and recharge before the next push: good.

hao.dich: One falls into the pit. Three uninvited guests arrive. Honour them, and in the end there will be good fortune.
hao.y: Unexpected help arrives; welcome it with respect.
hao.nom_na: Like unexpected visitors who turn out to bring help: be polite and open.

que_tu.dich: Conflict. You are sincere and are being obstructed. A cautious halt halfway brings good fortune; going through to the end brings misfortune. It furthers to see the great person. It does not further to cross the great water.

dai_tuong.dich: Heaven and water go their opposite ways: the image of conflict; the noble person, in all their dealings, carefully considers the beginning.

6.nom_na: Image: heaven goes up and water flows down — two sides pulling in opposite directions. In plain terms: like a dispute where you think you are right: find a fair middle way early; pushing it to the end costs both sides.

thoan.dich: Conflict: firmness above, danger below; danger joined with strength makes conflict. Conflict — being sincere and obstructed, a cautious halt halfway brings good fortune, because the firm line comes and takes the centre. Going through to the end brings misfortune: conflict must not be carried to completion. It furthers to see the great person, who values what is central and correct. It does not further to cross the great water: one would fall into the abyss.

hao.dich: If one does not perpetuate the affair, there is a little gossip. In the end, good fortune comes.
hao.y: Drop the dispute early; some talk, but it ends well.
hao.nom_na: Like letting a small argument go: a few words, then peace.

hao.dich: One cannot engage in conflict; one returns home, gives way. The people of his town, three hundred households, remain free of guilt.
hao.y: Pulling back from a fight you cannot win protects everyone.
hao.nom_na: Like stepping back from a fight with someone much stronger: your family stays safe.

hao.dich: To nourish oneself on ancient virtue induces perseverance. Danger. In the end, good fortune comes. If by chance you are in the service of a king, seek no works.
hao.y: Keep to what you already have and do not compete; it works out.
hao.nom_na: Like living on your savings and old reputation instead of fighting: safe in the end.

hao.dich: One cannot engage in conflict. One turns back and submits to fate, changes one's attitude, and finds peace in perseverance. Good fortune.
hao.y: Change your stance and accept things; peace returns.
hao.nom_na: Like realising you were wrong and changing course: things calm down.

hao.dich: To contend before him brings supreme good fortune.
hao.y: A fair judge settles the matter well.
hao.nom_na: Like taking a dispute to a fair mediator: it is resolved justly.

hao.dich: Even if by chance a leather belt is bestowed on one, by the end of a morning it will have been snatched away three times.
hao.y: What you win through conflict does not last.
hao.nom_na: Like winning an argument but losing the friendship: the victory slips away.

que_tu.dich: The Army. The army needs perseverance and an experienced leader. Good fortune without blame.

dai_tuong.dich: In the middle of the earth is water: the image of the army; the noble person, generous towards the people, increases their masses.

7.nom_na: Image: water hidden in the earth — a large force gathered and held. In plain terms: like running a big team: it works with a rightful aim, clear discipline and an experienced leader.

thoan.dich: The army means the masses; perseverance means being correct. One who can lead the masses rightly can become king. Firm and central, and met with response; going into danger yet staying devoted — with this one may afflict the world and the people still follow. Good fortune — and what blame could there be?

hao.dich: An army must set forth in proper order. If the order is not good, misfortune threatens.
hao.y: Start with clear rules; without them, things go wrong.
hao.nom_na: Like starting a project without clear roles: chaos follows.

hao.dich: In the midst of the army. Good fortune. No blame. The king bestows a triple decoration.
hao.y: The leader who stays with the team earns recognition.
hao.nom_na: Like a manager who works alongside their team: respected and rewarded.

hao.dich: Perchance the army carries corpses in the wagon. Misfortune.
hao.y: Too many people giving orders leads to failure.
hao.nom_na: Like a team with too many bosses: the project fails.

hao.dich: The army retreats. No blame.
hao.y: A wise retreat is not a failure.
hao.nom_na: Like stepping back from a losing battle: you save your strength.

hao.dich: There is game in the field. It furthers to catch it. No blame. Let the eldest lead the army. The younger transports corpses; then perseverance brings misfortune.
hao.y: Act against a real problem, but give the lead to the experienced person.
hao.nom_na: Like dealing with a genuine threat: put the most experienced person in charge, not the most eager.

hao.dich: The great prince issues commands, founds states, vests families with fiefs. Inferior people should not be employed.
hao.y: When the work is done, reward people according to their worth.
hao.nom_na: Like closing a project: thank and reward people, but do not give key roles to the wrong ones.

que_tu.dich: Holding Together brings good fortune. Inquire of the oracle once again whether you possess sublimity, constancy and perseverance; then there is no blame. Those who are uncertain gradually join. Whoever comes too late meets with misfortune.

dai_tuong.dich: On the earth is water: the image of holding together; the kings of old founded the states and kept friendly relations with the feudal lords.

8.nom_na: Image: water on the earth — they flow together and stick close. In plain terms: like finding a team or community to belong to: check your own sincerity, then join wholeheartedly; do not wait until it is too late.

thoan.dich: Holding together brings good fortune. Holding together means mutual help: those below follow with devotion. Inquiring of the oracle again whether one has sublimity, constancy and perseverance, without blame — this is because of firmness in the centre. Those who are uncertain gradually join, because above and below respond to one another. Whoever comes too late meets with misfortune: their way has come to an end.

hao.dich: Hold to them in truth and loyalty; this is without blame. Truth, like a full earthen bowl: thus in the end good fortune comes from without.
hao.y: Sincerity at the start brings support from unexpected places.
hao.nom_na: Like a new member who is simply honest and loyal: good luck comes from where you did not expect.

hao.dich: Hold to them inwardly. Perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Stay connected from the heart, without losing yourself.
hao.nom_na: Like being close to people while keeping your own values: good.

hao.dich: You hold together with the wrong people.
hao.y: These are not the right people to bond with.
hao.nom_na: Like getting close to people who do not share your values: it will hurt.

hao.dich: Hold to them outwardly also. Perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Openly support the right leader.
hao.nom_na: Like openly backing a good boss: things go well.

hao.dich: Manifestation of holding together. In the hunt the king uses beaters on three sides only and foregoes the game that runs off in front. The citizens need no warning. Good fortune.
hao.y: Draw people in without forcing them; let those who want to leave go.
hao.nom_na: Like a good leader who does not chase people: whoever stays, stays willingly.

hao.dich: He finds no head for holding together. Misfortune.
hao.y: Without a clear centre or start, the bond fails.
hao.nom_na: Like trying to join a group too late, with no one to lead you in: you stay outside.

que_tu.dich: Small Taming has success. Dense clouds, no rain from our western border.

dai_tuong.dich: The wind drives across heaven: the image of small taming; the noble person refines the outward aspect of their nature.

9.nom_na: Image: wind blowing across the sky — clouds gather but no rain falls yet. In plain terms: like small savings and small improvements: the big result has not come, but everything you add now counts.

thoan.dich: Small taming: the yielding line holds its place and those above and below respond to it — this is called small taming. Strong yet gentle, firm in the centre and its will is carried out — so there is success. Dense clouds but no rain: it is still moving on. From our western border: the blessing has not yet spread.

hao.dich: Return to the way. How could there be blame in this? Good fortune.
hao.y: Go back to your own path; that is right.
hao.nom_na: Like returning to what you do best after a detour: good.

hao.dich: He allows himself to be drawn into returning. Good fortune.
hao.y: Coming back together with others who think alike.
hao.nom_na: Like being brought back on track by a friend: good fortune.

hao.dich: The spokes burst out of the wagon wheels. Man and wife roll their eyes.
hao.y: Forcing things causes a breakdown and quarrels.
hao.nom_na: Like pushing too hard at home: the plan breaks down and the couple argue.

hao.dich: If you are sincere, blood vanishes and fear gives way. No blame.
hao.y: Sincerity removes the danger and the fear.
hao.nom_na: Like clearing the air with honesty: tension and worry fade.

hao.dich: If you are sincere and loyally attached, you are rich in your neighbour.
hao.y: Loyalty shared with others brings wealth to all.
hao.nom_na: Like a close-knit group of neighbours: everyone is better off.

hao.dich: The rain comes, there is rest. This is due to the lasting effect of character. Perseverance brings the woman into danger. The moon is nearly full. If the noble person persists, misfortune comes.
hao.y: The goal is reached; stop here and do not push further.
hao.nom_na: Like finally getting what you saved for: enjoy it, and do not push your luck.

que_tu.dich: Treading: treading on the tail of the tiger. It does not bite. Success.

dai_tuong.dich: Heaven above, the lake below: the image of treading; the noble person discriminates between high and low and so settles the minds of the people.

10.nom_na: Image: heaven above, the lake below — the weaker walks behind the stronger, as if behind a tiger. In plain terms: like working with a demanding boss or a powerful partner: courteous, correct and careful at each step, and you will not get 'bitten'.

thoan.dich: Treading: the yielding treads upon the firm. Joyful and responding to the Creative — so one treads on the tiger's tail and it does not bite; success. Firm, central and correct, one treads the place of the ruler without reproach, and the light shines.

hao.dich: Simple conduct. Progress without blame.
hao.y: Keep things simple and true to yourself at the start.
hao.nom_na: Like someone new at work: simple and genuine, doing your own job well, is enough.

hao.dich: Treading a smooth, level course. The perseverance of a quiet person brings good fortune.
hao.y: A straight path with little ambition and a calm mind is good.
hao.nom_na: Like living straightforwardly without elbowing others: a calm mind and calm affairs.

hao.dich: A one-eyed man is able to see, a lame man is able to tread. He treads on the tail of the tiger. The tiger bites the man. Misfortune. A warrior acts like this on behalf of his great prince.
hao.y: Overestimating yourself and taking risks is truly dangerous.
hao.nom_na: Like someone with little skill taking on an expert's job: real trouble follows.

hao.dich: He treads on the tail of the tiger. Caution and circumspection lead ultimately to good fortune.
hao.y: Risky work done with constant care gets through.
hao.nom_na: Like a high-risk job done with constant checking: you get through in the end.

hao.dich: Resolute conduct. Perseverance with awareness of danger.
hao.y: Being decisive is necessary, but staying rigid is dangerous.
hao.nom_na: Like a decisive person: good, but if they never bend, one day they break.

hao.dich: Look to your conduct and weigh the favourable signs. When everything is fulfilled, supreme good fortune comes.
hao.y: Look back over the whole journey and learn from it — that is a blessing.
hao.nom_na: Like looking back at the end of the year on the road you have travelled and drawing lessons: that is a blessing.

que_tu.dich: Peace. The small departs, the great approaches. Good fortune. Success.

dai_tuong.dich: Heaven and earth unite: the image of peace; the ruler divides and completes the course of heaven and earth, furthers and regulates their gifts, and so helps the people.

11.nom_na: Image: earth above, heaven below — the two meet and everything flows. In plain terms: like a smooth period at work and at home: use it to build foundations, and remember that good times also turn.

thoan.dich: Peace: the small departs, the great approaches; good fortune, success. Heaven and earth unite and all things flow freely; above and below unite and share one will. Yang within and yin without, strength within and devotion without, the noble person within and the petty person without: the way of the noble person grows, the way of the petty person fades.

hao.dich: When ribbon grass is pulled up, the sod comes with it. Each according to his kind. Undertakings bring good fortune.
hao.y: Act together with like-minded people.
hao.nom_na: Like pulling up grass and the roots coming with it: friends join in and things go well.

hao.dich: Bearing with the uncultured in gentleness, fording the river with resolution, not neglecting what is distant, not regarding one's companions: thus one may walk in the middle.
hao.y: Be generous and bold, remember the distant, and do not form cliques.
hao.nom_na: Like a fair-minded leader: accepting, brave, and not favouring friends.

hao.dich: No plain not followed by a slope. No going not followed by a return. He who remains persevering in danger is without blame. Do not complain about this truth; enjoy the good fortune you still possess.
hao.y: Every peak is followed by a slope; stay steady and enjoy what you have.
hao.nom_na: Like knowing that a good run will end: keep your head and enjoy it while it lasts.

hao.dich: He flutters down, not boasting of his wealth, together with his neighbour, guileless and sincere.
hao.y: Humble and sincere, you join with others easily.
hao.nom_na: Like someone who does not show off: people trust them naturally.

hao.dich: The sovereign I gives his daughter in marriage. This brings blessing and supreme good fortune.
hao.y: A union across differences in status brings great blessing.
hao.nom_na: Like a respectful alliance between unequal sides: very good fortune.

hao.dich: The wall falls back into the moat. Use no army now. Make your commands known within your own town. Perseverance brings humiliation.
hao.y: The good time is ending; do not fight it, tidy up close to home.
hao.nom_na: Like the end of a boom: do not force things, look after your own circle.

que_tu.dich: Standstill. Evil people do not further the perseverance of the noble person. The great departs; the small approaches.

dai_tuong.dich: Heaven and earth do not unite: the image of standstill; the noble person falls back on their inner worth to escape difficulties and does not seek honour or pay.

12.nom_na: Image: heaven above, earth below — moving apart, no exchange. In plain terms: like a time when nothing gets through, not at work and not at home: hold your principles, keep a low profile, and wait for the opening.

thoan.dich: Standstill: evil people do not further the perseverance of the noble person; the great departs, the small approaches. Heaven and earth do not unite and all things do not flow; above and below do not unite and there is no order in the world. Yin within and yang without, weak within and hard without, the petty person within and the noble person without: the way of the petty person grows, the way of the noble person fades.

hao.dich: When ribbon grass is pulled up, the sod comes with it. Each according to his kind. Perseverance brings good fortune and success.
hao.y: Stick with like-minded people and hold your principles.
hao.nom_na: Like a group of honest people who stay together in a bad time: in the end it works out.

hao.dich: They bear and endure; this means good fortune for inferior people. The standstill serves to help the great person to attain success.
hao.y: Those who flatter do well for now; the noble person bears the standstill and later succeeds.
hao.nom_na: Like refusing to curry favour in a bad environment: harder now, better later.

hao.dich: They bear shame.
hao.y: Getting ahead by improper means brings shame.
hao.nom_na: Like gaining a position you know you do not deserve: it brings a quiet shame.

hao.dich: He who acts at the command of the highest remains without blame. Those of like mind partake of the blessing.
hao.y: When the order is right, acting on it is safe and helps your companions.
hao.nom_na: Like taking action when you have proper backing: you and your colleagues benefit.

hao.dich: Standstill is giving way. Good fortune for the great person. 'What if it should fail, what if it should fail?' In this way he ties it to a cluster of mulberry shoots.
hao.y: The standstill begins to lift; stay alert and secure what you have.
hao.nom_na: Like a crisis easing: keep your guard up and tie things down firmly.

hao.dich: The standstill comes to an end. First standstill, then good fortune.
hao.y: The blockage is over; joy follows.
hao.nom_na: Like the end of a long, difficult stretch: first stuck, then relief.

que_tu.dich: Fellowship with people in the open. Success. It furthers to cross the great water. The perseverance of the noble person furthers.

dai_tuong.dich: Heaven together with fire: the image of fellowship; the noble person organises the clans and makes distinctions between things.

13.nom_na: Image: fire rising towards heaven — the same direction, the same light. In plain terms: like working with people from different groups: being open, fair and transparent makes things succeed; cliques make them small.

thoan.dich: Fellowship: the yielding line holds its place and the centre and responds to the Creative — this is called fellowship. Fellowship with people in the open, success; it furthers to cross the great water — this is the work of the Creative. Clear and strong, central and correct, and responding: this is the uprightness of the noble person. Only the noble person can unite the wills of everyone under heaven.

hao.dich: Fellowship with people at the gate. No blame.
hao.y: Openness at the start, without favourites, is right.
hao.nom_na: Like welcoming everyone at the door: a good start.

hao.dich: Fellowship with people in the clan. Humiliation.
hao.y: Sticking only to your own circle brings regret.
hao.nom_na: Like only working with relatives or old friends: narrow and limiting.

hao.dich: He hides weapons in the thicket; he climbs the high hill in front of it. For three years he does not rise up.
hao.y: Hidden suspicion and readiness to fight keep you stuck.
hao.nom_na: Like quietly preparing for a fight with a colleague: years go by and nothing changes.

hao.dich: He climbs up on his wall; he cannot attack. Good fortune.
hao.y: Stopping before you attack is good fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like getting ready to argue, then realising it is wrong and holding back: good.

hao.dich: People bound in fellowship first weep and lament, but afterwards they laugh. After great struggles they succeed in meeting.
hao.y: Hard at first, but the bond holds and joy follows.
hao.nom_na: Like friends separated by difficulties who finally meet again: tears, then laughter.

hao.dich: Fellowship with people in the meadow. No remorse.
hao.y: A modest, wider fellowship without great results, but no regret.
hao.nom_na: Like a loose community connection: nothing spectacular, but no regret.

que_tu.dich: Possession in Great Measure. Supreme success.

dai_tuong.dich: Fire high in heaven: the image of possession in great measure; the noble person curbs evil and furthers good, obeying the benevolent will of heaven.

14.nom_na: Image: fire high in the sky — shining on everything. In plain terms: like a time when you have plenty: share it, stay humble, and use it to do good.

thoan.dich: Possession in great measure: the yielding line holds the place of honour, great and central, and those above and below respond — this is called possession in great measure. Its virtue is firm and strong, clear and refined; it responds to heaven and moves with the time — so there is supreme success.

hao.dich: No relationship with what is harmful; there is no blame in this. If one remains conscious of difficulty, one remains without blame.
hao.y: Stay away from what harms you and remember the hard times.
hao.nom_na: Like someone newly comfortable who still remembers being poor: no trouble.

hao.dich: A big wagon for loading. One may undertake something. No blame.
hao.y: You have the capacity to carry a big task.
hao.nom_na: Like a solid vehicle that can carry a heavy load: take the job on.

hao.dich: A prince offers it to the Son of Heaven. A petty person cannot do this.
hao.y: Offer what you have to a greater purpose.
hao.nom_na: Like a successful person who gives back to the community: only a generous heart can do it.

hao.dich: He makes a difference between himself and his neighbour. No blame.
hao.y: Do not compete in showing off.
hao.nom_na: Like not trying to outdo the neighbours: no trouble.

hao.dich: He whose truth is accessible, yet dignified, has good fortune.
hao.y: Sincere and approachable, yet with dignity.
hao.nom_na: Like a boss who is friendly but firm: respected.

hao.dich: He is blessed by heaven. Good fortune. Nothing that does not further.
hao.y: When you are in tune with what is right, help comes from above.
hao.nom_na: Like someone whose good conduct brings luck from everywhere.

que_tu.dich: Modesty creates success. The noble person carries things through.

dai_tuong.dich: Within the earth, a mountain: the image of modesty; the noble person reduces what is too much and increases what is too little, weighing things and making them equal.

15.nom_na: Image: a mountain hidden inside the earth — something great that keeps itself low. In plain terms: like a capable person who does not show off: people trust and support them, and things turn out well.

thoan.dich: Modesty brings success. The way of heaven reaches down and shines; the way of earth is lowly and rises upward. The way of heaven diminishes the full and adds to the modest; the way of earth changes the full and flows towards the modest; spirits harm the full and bless the modest; people hate the full and love the modest. Modesty in a high place shines; in a low place it cannot be passed over. This is how the noble person reaches a good end.

hao.dich: A noble person modest about their modesty may cross the great water. Good fortune.
hao.y: Deep modesty lets you take on big things.
hao.nom_na: Like a quiet expert who never brags: trusted with big tasks.

hao.dich: Modesty that comes to expression. Perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Modesty that shows naturally is good.
hao.nom_na: Like a reputation for humility that grows on its own: good.

hao.dich: A noble person of modesty and merit carries things to conclusion. Good fortune.
hao.y: Working hard and staying modest leads to a good outcome.
hao.nom_na: Like the hardest worker who never asks for credit: in the end everyone sees it.

hao.dich: Nothing that would not further modesty in movement.
hao.y: Show modesty in everything you do.
hao.nom_na: Like being modest in every small action: everything goes smoothly.

hao.dich: No boasting of wealth before one's neighbour. It furthers to attack with force. Nothing that would not further.
hao.y: Modest, but firm when action is needed.
hao.nom_na: Like a humble person who still stands up firmly against wrongdoing: respected.

hao.dich: Modesty that comes to expression. It furthers to set armies marching to chastise one's own city and one's country.
hao.y: Use your modesty to put your own house in order.
hao.nom_na: Like someone who corrects their own team before blaming others: things improve.

que_tu.dich: Enthusiasm. It furthers to install helpers and to set armies marching.

dai_tuong.dich: Thunder comes resounding out of the earth: the image of enthusiasm; the ancient kings made music to honour merit and offered it to the Supreme Deity, inviting their ancestors to be present.

16.nom_na: Image: thunder bursting out of the earth — energy waking up. In plain terms: like the excitement at the start of a project or an event: use the energy to get everyone moving, but prepare properly and do not get carried away.

thoan.dich: Enthusiasm: the firm line finds response and its will is carried out; moving with devotion — that is enthusiasm. Because enthusiasm moves with devotion, heaven and earth are like it — how much more installing helpers and setting armies marching! Heaven and earth move with devotion, so the sun and moon do not stray and the four seasons do not err. The sage moves with devotion, so punishments are clear and the people obey. Great indeed is the meaning of the time of enthusiasm!

hao.dich: Enthusiasm that expresses itself brings misfortune.
hao.y: Boasting about your excitement or connections brings trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like bragging about who you know: it backfires.

hao.dich: Firm as a rock. Not a whole day. Perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Stay firm and see the warning signs early.
hao.nom_na: Like someone who keeps a cool head when everyone is carried away: they act at the right time.

hao.dich: Enthusiasm that looks upward creates remorse. Hesitation brings remorse.
hao.y: Waiting for others to lift your mood brings regret.
hao.nom_na: Like always looking to the boss for approval: regret, and waiting too long makes it worse.

hao.dich: The source of enthusiasm. He achieves great things. Doubt not. You gather friends around you as a hair clasp gathers the hair.
hao.y: You are the source of the energy; trust it and others gather.
hao.nom_na: Like the person whose enthusiasm holds the team together: do not doubt, people follow.

hao.dich: Persistently unwell, yet lives on.
hao.y: Under constant pressure, yet you hold on.
hao.nom_na: Like working under constant strain: it does not break you, but do not ignore it.

hao.dich: Deluded enthusiasm. But if after completion one changes, there is no blame.
hao.y: Lost in pleasure, but changing course in time is fine.
hao.nom_na: Like realising you have been partying too long and pulling yourself together: no harm done.

que_tu.dich: Following has supreme success. Perseverance furthers. No blame.

dai_tuong.dich: Thunder in the middle of the lake: the image of following; at nightfall the noble person goes indoors to rest.

17.nom_na: Image: thunder resting inside the lake — energy that yields to the season. In plain terms: like adapting to change at work: go with the times and follow what is right, but do not follow blindly.

thoan.dich: Following: the firm comes and places itself beneath the yielding; movement and joy — this is following. Great success through perseverance, without blame, and the whole world follows the time. Great indeed is the meaning of following the time!

hao.dich: The standard is changing. Perseverance brings good fortune. To go out of the door in company produces deeds.
hao.y: Things are changing; stay principled and open to others.
hao.nom_na: Like a reorganisation at work: keep your values and meet new people — it pays off.

hao.dich: If one clings to the little boy, one loses the strong man.
hao.y: Choosing the small means losing the big.
hao.nom_na: Like holding on to an easy, small option and missing a real opportunity.

hao.dich: If one clings to the strong man, one loses the little boy. Through following one finds what one seeks. It furthers to remain persevering.
hao.y: Choosing what matters means letting go of the lesser; stay steady.
hao.nom_na: Like leaving a comfortable small job for a real mentor: you get what you are after.

hao.dich: Following creates success. Perseverance brings misfortune. To go one's way with sincerity brings clarity. How could there be blame in this?
hao.y: Gaining followers can cause suspicion; stay sincere and clear.
hao.nom_na: Like becoming popular at work: be transparent so no one thinks you are scheming.

hao.dich: Sincere in the good. Good fortune.
hao.y: Follow what is good wholeheartedly.
hao.nom_na: Like committing sincerely to a good cause: good fortune.

hao.dich: He meets with firm allegiance and is still further bound. The king introduces him to the western mountain.
hao.y: A deep, lasting bond of loyalty.
hao.nom_na: Like a lifelong loyalty to a cause or a person: honoured.

que_tu.dich: Work on What Has Been Spoiled has supreme success. It furthers to cross the great water. Before the starting point, three days; after the starting point, three days.

dai_tuong.dich: The wind blows low on the mountain: the image of decay; the noble person stirs up the people and strengthens their spirit.

18.nom_na: Image: wind trapped at the foot of a mountain — air that does not move goes stale. In plain terms: like fixing an old problem everyone has ignored: find the root, plan the repair, and see it through.

thoan.dich: Work on what has been spoiled: the firm is above and the yielding below; gentle and standing still — that is decay. Work on what has been spoiled has supreme success, and the world is set in order. It furthers to cross the great water: going brings things to do. Three days before the start and three days after: every ending has a new beginning — that is the way of heaven.

hao.dich: Setting right what has been spoiled by the father. If there is a son, no blame rests upon the departed father. Danger. In the end, good fortune.
hao.y: Fixing an inherited problem; hard, but it ends well.
hao.nom_na: Like taking over a family business with problems and sorting them out: risky, but good in the end.

hao.dich: Setting right what has been spoiled by the mother. One must not be too persevering.
hao.y: Fix the problem gently, not harshly.
hao.nom_na: Like correcting a parent's mistake: be tactful, not rigid.

hao.dich: Setting right what has been spoiled by the father. There will be a little remorse. No great blame.
hao.y: Some friction in fixing things, but no real harm.
hao.nom_na: Like changing the old way of doing things: a few hurt feelings, but no big mistake.

hao.dich: Tolerating what has been spoiled by the father. In continuing one sees humiliation.
hao.y: Letting the problem slide only makes it worse.
hao.nom_na: Like turning a blind eye to an old problem: it comes back to embarrass you.

hao.dich: Setting right what has been spoiled by the father. One meets with praise.
hao.y: Fixing things well brings recognition.
hao.nom_na: Like successfully turning around something that was failing: you are praised for it.

hao.dich: He does not serve kings and princes; he sets himself higher goals.
hao.y: Stepping back from worldly affairs for a higher purpose.
hao.nom_na: Like leaving the race for status to do work that truly matters to you.

que_tu.dich: Approach has supreme success. Perseverance furthers. When the eighth month comes, there will be misfortune.

dai_tuong.dich: The earth above the lake: the image of approach; the noble person is inexhaustible in teaching and boundless in caring for and protecting the people.

19.nom_na: Image: earth rising above the lake — standing close and looking after what is below. In plain terms: like a time of growth and new responsibility: draw close to people, lead well, and remember the good run has a limit.

thoan.dich: Approach: the firm gradually grows. Joyful and devoted, firm in the centre and met with response, great success through what is right — this is the way of heaven. When the eighth month comes there will be misfortune: the decline will not be long in coming.

hao.dich: Joint approach. Perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Approach together with others, staying principled.
hao.nom_na: Like starting something new with a good team: good.

hao.dich: Joint approach. Good fortune. Everything furthers.
hao.y: Working together, everything goes well.
hao.nom_na: Like a team that moves forward together: everything works out.

hao.dich: Comfortable approach. Nothing that would further. If one is induced to grieve over it, one becomes free of blame.
hao.y: Easy, careless approach brings no good; notice it and correct it.
hao.nom_na: Like coasting on charm: it gets you nowhere — notice it and change.

hao.dich: Complete approach. No blame.
hao.y: Coming close and fully engaged is right.
hao.nom_na: Like a manager who really gets involved: no mistake.

hao.dich: Wise approach. This is right for a great prince. Good fortune.
hao.y: Lead with wisdom, by choosing and trusting good people.
hao.nom_na: Like a wise leader who knows whom to rely on: good fortune.

hao.dich: Greathearted approach. Good fortune. No blame.
hao.y: Generous, sincere engagement brings good fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like someone experienced who generously helps the next generation: good.

que_tu.dich: Contemplation. The ablution has been made, but not yet the offering. Full of trust, they look up to him.

dai_tuong.dich: The wind blows over the earth: the image of contemplation; the kings of old visited the regions, observed the people and set up instruction.

20.nom_na: Image: wind moving over the land — touching everything and being seen everywhere. In plain terms: like taking a step back to look at the whole picture before acting, and remembering that others are watching you too.

thoan.dich: The great one is above for all to see, devoted and gentle, central and correct, contemplating the world. Contemplation — the ablution made but not yet the offering, full of trust they look up to him: those below look and are transformed. Contemplating the divine way of heaven, the four seasons never err; the sage uses the divine way to instruct, and the whole world submits.

hao.dich: Boylike contemplation. For an inferior person, no blame. For a noble person, humiliation.
hao.y: A shallow view is fine for a beginner, not for a leader.
hao.nom_na: Like judging by first impressions: forgivable when you are new, embarrassing when you are in charge.

hao.dich: Contemplation through the crack of the door. Furthering for the perseverance of a woman.
hao.y: A narrow view from your own corner.
hao.nom_na: Like peeking through a gap: you see only part of the picture.

hao.dich: Contemplation of my life decides the choice between advance and retreat.
hao.y: Look at your own life to decide whether to move forward or back.
hao.nom_na: Like reviewing your own track record before deciding on a new step.

hao.dich: Contemplation of the light of the kingdom. It furthers one to exert influence as the guest of a king.
hao.y: Seeing the bigger picture and serving it well.
hao.nom_na: Like visiting a successful company and being invited to contribute: good.

hao.dich: Contemplation of my life. The noble person is without blame.
hao.y: Examine yourself, especially the effect you have on others.
hao.nom_na: Like a leader checking whether their own behaviour is the right example.

hao.dich: Contemplation of his life. The noble person is without blame.
hao.y: Look at yourself from the outside, with detachment.
hao.nom_na: Like an elder reflecting calmly on their life: no blame.

que_tu.dich: Biting Through has success. It is favourable to let justice be administered.

dai_tuong.dich: Thunder and lightning: the image of biting through; the kings of old made firm the laws through clearly defined penalties.

21.nom_na: Image: thunder and lightning together — a decisive strike that clears the air. In plain terms: like a problem stuck in the middle of everything: name it, deal with it firmly and fairly, and things can move again.

thoan.dich: There is something between the jaws: this is called biting through. Biting through brings success. The firm and the yielding are separated; movement and clarity; thunder and lightning unite and shine. The yielding line holds the centre and rises; though not in its proper place, it is favourable to administer justice.

hao.dich: His feet are fastened in the stocks, so that his toes disappear. No blame.
hao.y: A small correction early prevents bigger trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like a warning for a first small mistake: it stops a bigger one.

hao.dich: Bites through tender meat, so that his nose disappears. No blame.
hao.y: Dealing firmly with an easy case, perhaps too hard, but no blame.
hao.nom_na: Like being a bit too strict with a small issue: forgivable.

hao.dich: Bites on old dried meat and strikes on something poisonous. Slight humiliation. No blame.
hao.y: Tackling an old problem brings some unpleasantness, but no real fault.
hao.nom_na: Like digging into an old dispute: some bad feeling, but you were right to do it.

hao.dich: Bites on dried gristly meat. Receives metal arrows. It furthers one to be mindful of difficulties and to be persevering. Good fortune.
hao.y: A hard case needs firmness and care; it works out.
hao.nom_na: Like a tough negotiation: stay firm and careful and you succeed.

hao.dich: Bites on dried lean meat. Receives yellow gold. Persevering, aware of danger. No blame.
hao.y: Being fair and firm in a hard case is right.
hao.nom_na: Like making a fair but tough decision as a leader: no blame if you stay aware of the risks.

hao.dich: His neck is fastened in the wooden cangue, so that his ears disappear. Misfortune.
hao.y: Refusing to listen to warnings leads to serious trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like ignoring every warning until it is too late.

que_tu.dich: Grace has success. In small matters it is favourable to undertake something.

dai_tuong.dich: Fire at the foot of the mountain: the image of grace; the noble person brings clarity to everyday affairs but dares not decide great controversies this way.

22.nom_na: Image: fire lighting up the foot of a mountain — beautiful, but only on the surface. In plain terms: like making something look good: presentation helps, but the substance underneath is what counts.

thoan.dich: Grace has success: the yielding comes and adorns the firm, so there is success. The firm rises and adorns the yielding, so in small matters it is favourable to undertake something. This is the pattern of heaven; clarity held within limits is the pattern of human culture. Contemplating the pattern of heaven one perceives the changing seasons; contemplating the pattern of human culture one can shape the world.

hao.dich: He lends grace to his toes, leaves the carriage and walks.
hao.y: Choose simple honesty over a show.
hao.nom_na: Like walking rather than accepting a ride you have not earned.

hao.dich: Lends grace to the beard on his chin.
hao.y: Appearance follows substance.
hao.nom_na: Like a beard that only moves with the chin: looks depend on what is underneath.

hao.dich: Graceful and moist. Constant perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Things look good; keep up the effort so it lasts.
hao.nom_na: Like a good period that is pleasant: do not let it make you lazy.

hao.dich: Grace or simplicity? A white horse comes as if on wings. He is not a robber; he will woo at the right time.
hao.y: Choosing simplicity, a sincere connection arrives.
hao.nom_na: Like turning down flashy offers and finding a sincere partner instead.

hao.dich: Grace in hills and gardens. The roll of silk is meagre and small. Humiliation, but in the end good fortune.
hao.y: A modest offering, sincerely given, ends well.
hao.nom_na: Like a small gift that seems too little but is received warmly.

hao.dich: Simple grace. No blame.
hao.y: The highest grace is simplicity.
hao.nom_na: Like a plain, honest style that needs no decoration: no blame.

que_tu.dich: Splitting Apart. It does not further one to go anywhere.

dai_tuong.dich: The mountain rests on the earth: the image of splitting apart; those above can secure their position only by giving generously to those below.

23.nom_na: Image: a mountain worn away down to the ground — something being stripped bit by bit. In plain terms: like a time when your base is being eroded: stop expanding, protect what matters most, and wait for the turn.

thoan.dich: Splitting apart means stripping away: the yielding changes the firm. It does not further to go anywhere: the petty are growing. Devoted and standing still, one observes the image. The noble person heeds the rise and fall, the filling and emptying — that is the way of heaven.

hao.dich: The leg of the bed is split. Those who persevere are destroyed. Misfortune.
hao.y: The base starts to be eaten away; take it seriously.
hao.nom_na: Like the first signs of a business losing its footing: deal with it.

hao.dich: The bed is split at the edge. Those who persevere are destroyed. Misfortune.
hao.y: The erosion moves closer to you.
hao.nom_na: Like the trouble reaching your own desk: time to act carefully.

hao.dich: He splits with them. No blame.
hao.y: Separating from a harmful group is right.
hao.nom_na: Like leaving a group that is doing harm: no blame.

hao.dich: The bed is split up to the skin. Misfortune.
hao.y: The damage has reached you directly.
hao.nom_na: Like the problem now affecting you personally: protect yourself.

hao.dich: A shoal of fishes. Favour comes through the court ladies. Everything acts to further.
hao.y: Bringing people into order through goodwill turns things around.
hao.nom_na: Like a good leader bringing everyone into line kindly: things improve.

hao.dich: There is a large fruit still uneaten. The noble person receives a carriage. The house of the inferior person is split apart.
hao.y: What is good survives the decline and becomes the seed of renewal.
hao.nom_na: Like the one good thing left after a crisis: it is the start of the next chapter.

que_tu.dich: Return. Success. Going out and coming in without error. Friends come without blame. To and fro goes the way. On the seventh day comes return. It furthers one to have somewhere to go.

dai_tuong.dich: Thunder within the earth: the image of the turning point; the kings of old closed the passes at the time of the solstice, merchants did not travel and the ruler did not tour the provinces.

24.nom_na: Image: thunder stirring deep in the earth — the first sign of new life. In plain terms: like the moment after a setback when things begin to turn: start again in small steps and come back to what is right.

thoan.dich: Return, success: the firm comes back. Movement in devotion — so going out and coming in without error, friends come without blame. To and fro goes the way, on the seventh day comes return — this is the way of heaven. It furthers to have somewhere to go: the firm is growing. In return one sees the heart of heaven and earth.

hao.dich: Return from a short distance. No need for remorse. Great good fortune.
hao.y: Correct a mistake quickly and there is no regret.
hao.nom_na: Like noticing a wrong turn straight away and going back: very good.

hao.dich: Quiet return. Good fortune.
hao.y: Coming back gently, helped by good people.
hao.nom_na: Like returning to the right path with the help of a good friend.

hao.dich: Repeated return. Danger. No blame.
hao.y: Going back and forth is risky but not wrong.
hao.nom_na: Like falling into the same habit again and again but always trying: keep going.

hao.dich: Walking in the midst of others, one returns alone.
hao.y: Choosing the right path on your own.
hao.nom_na: Like leaving the crowd to do what is right.

hao.dich: Noblehearted return. No remorse.
hao.y: Returning sincerely, with your heart in it.
hao.nom_na: Like a sincere change of heart: no regret.

hao.dich: Missing the return. Misfortune. Misfortune from within and without. If armies are set marching in this way, one will in the end suffer a great defeat, disastrous for the ruler of the country. For ten years it will not be possible to attack again.
hao.y: Refusing to come back to the right way leads to a long, hard setback.
hao.nom_na: Like refusing to admit a mistake: the damage lasts a long time.

que_tu.dich: Innocence. Supreme success. Perseverance furthers. If someone is not as they should be, they have misfortune, and it does not further them to undertake anything.

dai_tuong.dich: Under heaven thunder rolls, and all things share in innocence; the kings of old, rich in virtue and in harmony with the time, fostered all beings.

25.nom_na: Image: thunder rolling under the sky — everything moves naturally, without scheming. In plain terms: like acting honestly and simply, without calculation: you stay in tune with things; trying to manipulate the outcome brings trouble.

thoan.dich: Innocence: the firm comes from outside and becomes master within. Movement and strength, firm in the centre and met with response: great success through what is right — this is the will of heaven. If someone is not as they should be, they have misfortune and should not undertake anything. Where can innocence go, when the will of heaven does not protect it?

hao.dich: Innocent behaviour brings good fortune.
hao.y: Acting from a sincere heart goes well.
hao.nom_na: Like starting something with honest intentions: good.

hao.dich: If one does not count on the harvest while ploughing, nor on the use of the ground while clearing it, it furthers one to undertake something.
hao.y: Do the work without fixating on the reward.
hao.nom_na: Like doing your job well without constantly counting the payoff: things go well.

hao.dich: Undeserved misfortune. The cow that was tethered by someone is the wanderer's gain, the citizen's loss.
hao.y: Sometimes trouble comes that is not your fault.
hao.nom_na: Like being blamed for something someone else did: unfair, but it passes.

hao.dich: He who can be persevering remains without blame.
hao.y: Keep to what is right and there is no fault.
hao.nom_na: Like holding to your principles under pressure: no blame.

hao.dich: Use no medicine in an illness incurred through no fault of your own. It will pass of itself.
hao.y: Trouble that is not of your making often passes by itself; do not overreact (a symbolic image, not medical advice).
hao.nom_na: Like a problem you did not cause: it often settles on its own — do not make it worse.

hao.dich: Innocent action brings misfortune. Nothing furthers.
hao.y: Acting at the wrong time, even with good intentions, brings trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like pushing ahead naively when it is time to stop: nothing good comes of it.

que_tu.dich: The Taming Power of the Great. Perseverance furthers. Not eating at home brings good fortune. It furthers one to cross the great water.

dai_tuong.dich: Heaven within the mountain: the image of the taming power of the great; the noble person acquaints themselves with many sayings of antiquity and deeds of the past, to strengthen their character.

26.nom_na: Image: heaven held inside a mountain — great strength stored and kept in check. In plain terms: like years of study and saving: build up deeply, hold back until the right time, then step out and serve.

thoan.dich: The taming power of the great: firm and strong, genuine and true, shining with light, renewing its virtue day by day. The firm rises and honours the worthy; it can hold strength in check — that is great correctness. Not eating at home brings good fortune: the worthy are nourished. It furthers to cross the great water: it responds to heaven.

hao.dich: Danger is at hand. It furthers one to desist.
hao.y: There is danger; better to stop for now.
hao.nom_na: Like an obstacle in your way: wait, do not force it.

hao.dich: The axletrees are taken from the wagon.
hao.y: Holding still on purpose is the wise choice.
hao.nom_na: Like deciding not to drive in a storm: you stay put.

hao.dich: A good horse that follows others. Awareness of danger, with perseverance, furthers. Practise chariot driving and armed defence daily. It furthers to have somewhere to go.
hao.y: The way is opening; keep training and stay careful.
hao.nom_na: Like getting the green light after long preparation: go, but keep practising.

hao.dich: The headboard of a young bull. Great good fortune.
hao.y: Restrain things early, before they grow strong.
hao.nom_na: Like setting good habits in a young team: very good.

hao.dich: The tusk of a gelded boar. Good fortune.
hao.y: Take away the cause rather than fighting the symptom.
hao.nom_na: Like removing the root of a problem instead of fighting it every day.

hao.dich: One attains the way of heaven. Success.
hao.y: The time of holding back is over; the way is open.
hao.nom_na: Like the moment all your preparation pays off: the road is clear.

que_tu.dich: The Corners of the Mouth (providing nourishment). Perseverance brings good fortune. Pay heed to the providing of nourishment and to what a person seeks to fill their own mouth with.

dai_tuong.dich: At the foot of the mountain, thunder: the image of providing nourishment; the noble person is careful of their words and temperate in eating and drinking.

27.nom_na: Image: thunder under the mountain — like a jaw that moves to chew. In plain terms: like looking at what you feed yourself every day — food, words, thoughts — and what you feed others: nourish what is right.

thoan.dich: Nourishment: perseverance brings good fortune — nourishing what is right brings good fortune. Pay heed to the providing of nourishment: look at what someone nourishes. What a person seeks to fill their own mouth with: look at how they nourish themselves. Heaven and earth nourish all things; the sage nourishes the worthy and through them all the people. Great indeed is the time of nourishment!

hao.dich: You let your magic tortoise go, and look at me with the corners of your mouth drooping. Misfortune.
hao.y: Envying others and neglecting your own resources.
hao.nom_na: Like looking at what others have and forgetting your own strengths: bad.

hao.dich: Turning to the summit for nourishment, deviating from the path to seek nourishment from the hill. Continuing to do this brings misfortune.
hao.y: Seeking support in the wrong places.
hao.nom_na: Like relying on the wrong people for your living: it ends badly.

hao.dich: Turning away from nourishment. Perseverance brings misfortune. Do not act thus for ten years. Nothing serves to further.
hao.y: Feeding on what is unhealthy does long-lasting harm.
hao.nom_na: Like a habit that feeds you the wrong things: it causes long-term harm.

hao.dich: Turning to the summit for provision of nourishment brings good fortune. Spying about with sharp eyes like a tiger with insatiable craving. No blame.
hao.y: Seeking help from above for a good cause is right.
hao.nom_na: Like a capable person looking eagerly for support for a worthy project: no blame.

hao.dich: Turning away from the path. To remain persevering brings good fortune. One should not cross the great water.
hao.y: You are not yet able to go it alone; stay steady.
hao.nom_na: Like a leader who still needs advisers: stay put, do not take a big risk.

hao.dich: The source of nourishment. Awareness of danger brings good fortune. It furthers one to cross the great water.
hao.y: You are the one others rely on; carry it with care.
hao.nom_na: Like the person who feeds the whole family: a heavy duty, but you can take on big things.

que_tu.dich: Preponderance of the Great. The ridgepole sags to breaking point. It furthers one to have somewhere to go. Success.

dai_tuong.dich: The lake rises above the trees: the image of preponderance of the great; the noble person, when they stand alone, is unconcerned, and if they must withdraw from the world, they are undaunted.

28.nom_na: Image: lake water rising over the trees — far more weight than things can carry. In plain terms: like being overloaded at work or at home: admit it, and dare to make a well-planned change before something breaks.

thoan.dich: Preponderance of the great: the great is in excess. The ridgepole sags: the beginning and the end are weak. The firm is in excess but holds the centre; gentle and joyful in action — so it furthers to have somewhere to go, and there is success. Great indeed is the time of preponderance of the great!

hao.dich: To spread white rushes underneath. No blame.
hao.y: Great caution at the start is right.
hao.nom_na: Like packing something fragile with extra care: no blame.

hao.dich: A dry poplar sprouts at the root. An older man takes a young wife. Everything furthers.
hao.y: Renewal comes from an unexpected combination.
hao.nom_na: Like an old business revived by new energy: it works.

hao.dich: The ridgepole sags to breaking point. Misfortune.
hao.y: Pushing on stubbornly under too much weight leads to a break.
hao.nom_na: Like refusing help while carrying too much: something gives way.

hao.dich: The ridgepole is braced. Good fortune. If there are ulterior motives, it is humiliating.
hao.y: With support, the load can be carried; stay clean.
hao.nom_na: Like getting the right help in time: good, as long as there are no hidden agendas.

hao.dich: A withered poplar puts forth flowers. An older woman takes a husband. No blame. No praise.
hao.y: A late bloom that does not last long.
hao.nom_na: Like a short burst of activity at the end of a cycle: no harm, no lasting gain.

hao.dich: One must go through the water. It goes over one's head. Misfortune. No blame.
hao.y: Taking on too much, you may go under, but your intention was not wrong.
hao.nom_na: Like taking on an impossible task out of duty: it may fail, but it is not a fault.

que_tu.dich: The Abysmal repeated. If you are sincere, you have success in your heart, and whatever you do succeeds.

dai_tuong.dich: Water flows on uninterruptedly and reaches its goal: the image of the abysmal repeated; the noble person walks in lasting virtue and carries on the business of teaching.

29.nom_na: Image: water upon water — one danger after another. In plain terms: like a hard stretch where problems keep coming: stay sincere and steady like flowing water, go through one step at a time, and you get through.

thoan.dich: The abysmal repeated is double danger. Water flows and does not overflow; it goes through danger and does not lose its trustworthiness. Success in the heart comes from firmness in the centre. Whatever you do succeeds: going on brings achievement. The danger of heaven cannot be climbed; the dangers of earth are mountains, rivers, hills; kings and princes use danger to protect their lands. Great indeed is the use of the time of danger!

hao.dich: Repetition of the abysmal. In the abyss one falls into a pit. Misfortune.
hao.y: Getting used to danger, you sink deeper.
hao.nom_na: Like getting used to a bad situation: you sink further into it.

hao.dich: The abyss is dangerous. One should strive to attain small things only.
hao.y: In danger, aim only for small steps.
hao.nom_na: Like being in a crisis: go for small wins only.

hao.dich: Forward and backward, abyss on abyss. In danger like this, pause at first and wait, otherwise you will fall into a pit in the abyss. Do not act in this way.
hao.y: Danger in every direction; do not move yet.
hao.nom_na: Like every option looking risky: stop and wait.

hao.dich: A jug of wine, a bowl of rice with it; earthen vessels simply handed in through the window. There is certainly no blame in this.
hao.y: In hard times, simple sincerity is enough.
hao.nom_na: Like a simple, honest gesture in a crisis: it is enough.

hao.dich: The abyss is not filled to overflowing; it is filled only to the rim. No blame.
hao.y: The danger is levelling out; do not overreach.
hao.nom_na: Like the worst being nearly over: do not take on more than you need.

hao.dich: Bound with cords and ropes, shut in between thorn-hedged prison walls: for three years one does not find the way. Misfortune.
hao.y: Stuck by your own mistakes for a long time.
hao.nom_na: Like being trapped by your own choices: it takes a long time to get free.

que_tu.dich: The Clinging. Perseverance furthers. It brings success. Care of the cow brings good fortune.

dai_tuong.dich: That which is bright rises twice: the image of fire; the great person, by perpetuating this brightness, illumines the four quarters of the world.

30.nom_na: Image: fire upon fire — light that needs something to burn on. In plain terms: like someone who shines brightly: hold on to what is right and stay gentle inside, so the light does not burn out.

thoan.dich: The clinging means resting on something. Sun and moon rest on heaven, grain, grass and trees rest on the earth. Doubled clarity rests on what is right and so transforms and perfects the world. The yielding rests on what is central and correct, so there is success; therefore care of the cow brings good fortune.

hao.dich: The footprints run criss-cross. If one is seriously intent, no blame.
hao.y: Starting out, many paths cross; stay serious and focused.
hao.nom_na: Like the busy start of a day: focus and you avoid mistakes.

hao.dich: Yellow light. Supreme good fortune.
hao.y: Balanced clarity brings great good fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like a calm, clear mind at the right moment: very good.

hao.dich: In the light of the setting sun, people either beat the pot and sing or loudly bewail the approach of old age. Misfortune.
hao.y: Facing the end of a cycle, accept it rather than despair.
hao.nom_na: Like coming to the end of a stage of life: enjoy it calmly instead of grieving.

hao.dich: Its coming is sudden; it flames up, dies down, is thrown away.
hao.y: What flares up too fast burns out fast (a symbolic image).
hao.nom_na: Like someone who rises too fast and too loudly: they fade just as fast.

hao.dich: Tears in floods, sighing and lamenting. Good fortune.
hao.y: Sincere sorrow and change of heart bring good fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like deeply regretting a mistake and changing: it turns out well.

hao.dich: The king uses him to march forth and chastise. Then it is best to remove the ringleaders and spare the followers. No blame.
hao.y: Deal with the root of the problem, not with everyone around it.
hao.nom_na: Like fixing what really causes the trouble, without punishing everyone: no blame.

que_tu.dich: Influence. Success. Perseverance furthers. To take a maiden to wife brings good fortune.

dai_tuong.dich: A lake on the mountain: the image of influence; the noble person encourages people to approach by their readiness to receive them.

31.nom_na: Image: a lake resting on a mountain — the two touch and respond to each other. In plain terms: like the start of a real connection: open, sincere and receptive — not pushing, not just a passing thrill.

thoan.dich: Influence means stimulation. The yielding is above and the firm below; the two forces stimulate and respond to each other. Keeping still and joyful, the man places himself below the woman; so there is success, perseverance furthers, and taking a maiden to wife brings good fortune. Heaven and earth stimulate each other and all things are created; the sage stimulates the hearts of people and the world has peace. Look at what stimulates things, and the nature of heaven, earth and all beings can be seen.

hao.dich: The influence shows itself in the big toe.
hao.y: The very first stirrings, not yet acted on.
hao.nom_na: Like the first spark of interest: it has not shown in action yet.

hao.dich: The influence shows itself in the calves of the legs. Misfortune. Tarrying brings good fortune.
hao.y: Rushing to act on a feeling brings trouble; wait.
hao.nom_na: Like wanting to act immediately on a feeling: better to wait.

hao.dich: The influence shows itself in the thighs. Holds to that which follows it. To continue is humiliating.
hao.y: Following every impulse leads to embarrassment.
hao.nom_na: Like going along with every passing urge: you regret it.

hao.dich: Perseverance brings good fortune. Remorse disappears. If a person is agitated in mind, and their thoughts go back and forth, only those friends on whom they fix their conscious thoughts will follow.
hao.y: Steady sincerity wins people; anxious scheming narrows your circle.
hao.nom_na: Like trying too hard to be liked: calm sincerity works better.

hao.dich: The influence shows itself in the back of the neck. No remorse.
hao.y: A firm but limited influence; no regret.
hao.nom_na: Like a decision taken firmly and without fuss: no regret.

hao.dich: The influence shows itself in the jaws, cheeks and tongue.
hao.y: Influence through words alone is shallow.
hao.nom_na: Like a lot of talk without action: it does not go deep.

que_tu.dich: Duration. Success. No blame. Perseverance furthers. It furthers one to have somewhere to go.

dai_tuong.dich: Thunder and wind: the image of duration; the noble person stands firm and does not change direction.

32.nom_na: Image: thunder and wind always together — a pair that lasts. In plain terms: like a long marriage or a long career: steady commitment and good habits keep it going.

thoan.dich: Duration means long-lasting. The firm is above and the yielding below; thunder and wind work together; gentle and moving; the firm and the yielding all respond — that is duration. Duration brings success without blame; perseverance furthers — enduring in one's way. The way of heaven and earth is lasting and never ends. It furthers to have somewhere to go: every ending has a new beginning. Sun and moon, held by heaven, shine for ever; the four seasons change and so endure; the sage endures in their way and the world is transformed. Look at what endures, and the nature of heaven, earth and all beings can be seen.

hao.dich: Seeking duration too hastily brings misfortune persistently. Nothing that would further.
hao.y: Wanting permanence too quickly backfires.
hao.nom_na: Like demanding a lifelong promise on a first date: it goes wrong.

hao.dich: Remorse disappears.
hao.y: Staying balanced, regret falls away.
hao.nom_na: Like keeping a steady middle way: regrets fade.

hao.dich: He who does not give duration to his character meets with disgrace. Persistent humiliation.
hao.y: Being inconsistent costs you respect.
hao.nom_na: Like someone who keeps changing their word: people stop trusting them.

hao.dich: No game in the field.
hao.y: Persisting in the wrong place gets you nothing.
hao.nom_na: Like fishing where there are no fish: no matter how long you stay.

hao.dich: Giving duration to one's character through perseverance. This is good fortune for a woman, misfortune for a man.
hao.y: Constancy must suit the situation; blind loyalty is not always right.
hao.nom_na: Like being loyal in a way that suits a supporting role but not a leading one.

hao.dich: Restlessness as an enduring condition brings misfortune.
hao.y: Constant restlessness ruins what lasts.
hao.nom_na: Like never settling, always shaking things up: it wears everything out.

que_tu.dich: Retreat. Success. In what is small, perseverance furthers.

dai_tuong.dich: Mountain under heaven: the image of retreat; the noble person keeps petty people at a distance, not angrily but with reserve.

33.nom_na: Image: the mountain rises but heaven withdraws ever higher — keeping a distance on purpose. In plain terms: like leaving a toxic situation in time: step back to protect your strength and principles — it is not running away.

thoan.dich: Retreat brings success: retreating, one succeeds. The firm holds its proper place and is met with response; it moves with the time. In what is small, perseverance furthers: the petty are slowly growing. Great indeed is the meaning of the time of retreat!

hao.dich: At the tail in retreat. This is dangerous. One must not wish to undertake anything.
hao.y: Retreating too late is dangerous; do not start anything.
hao.nom_na: Like leaving last when everyone else has gone: risky — keep still.

hao.dich: He holds him fast with yellow oxhide. No one can tear him loose.
hao.y: Hold firmly to what is right; no one can pull you away.
hao.nom_na: Like keeping a promise firmly while others leave: steadfast.

hao.dich: A halted retreat is nerve-wracking and dangerous. To retain people as menservants and maidservants brings good fortune.
hao.y: Being tied down when you should leave is stressful; manage what is close to you.
hao.nom_na: Like wanting to quit but being held back by obligations: look after the small things you can control.

hao.dich: Voluntary retreat brings good fortune to the noble person and downfall to the petty person.
hao.y: Leaving willingly, at the right time, is good for the wise.
hao.nom_na: Like stepping away on your own terms: the wise benefit, the stubborn lose.

hao.dich: Friendly retreat. Perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Leaving on good terms is good fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like leaving a job gracefully: good.

hao.dich: Cheerful retreat. Everything serves to further.
hao.y: Leaving freely, with nothing to regret.
hao.nom_na: Like retiring happily at the right time: everything goes well.

que_tu.dich: The Power of the Great. Perseverance furthers.

dai_tuong.dich: Thunder in heaven above: the image of the power of the great; the noble person does not tread upon paths that do not accord with established order.

34.nom_na: Image: thunder high in the sky — great power that is felt everywhere. In plain terms: like having a lot of momentum: use it with restraint and good form, not like a ram charging a fence.

thoan.dich: The power of the great: what is great is powerful. Firm and moving, therefore powerful. The power of the great furthers through perseverance: what is great is right. Through what is right and great, the nature of heaven and earth can be seen!

hao.dich: Power in the toes. Continuing brings misfortune. This is certainly true.
hao.y: Strength at the very start, pushed forward, brings trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like a newcomer pushing too hard: it backfires.

hao.dich: Perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Strength held in balance is good.
hao.nom_na: Like being strong but steady: good.

hao.dich: The inferior person works through power. The noble person does not act thus. To continue is dangerous. A goat butts against a hedge and gets its horns entangled.
hao.y: Using force gets you stuck.
hao.nom_na: Like a ram charging a fence and getting its horns caught: force traps you.
