hao.dich: Perseverance brings good fortune. Remorse disappears. The hedge opens; there is no entanglement. Power depends upon the axle of a big cart.
hao.y: Steady strength opens the way.
hao.nom_na: Like steady persistence that finally breaks through: the way opens.

hao.dich: Loses the goat with ease. No remorse.
hao.y: Giving up stubbornness easily brings no regret.
hao.nom_na: Like letting go of a fight easily: no regret.

hao.dich: A goat butts against a hedge. It cannot go backward, it cannot go forward. Nothing serves to further. If one notes the difficulty, this brings good fortune.
hao.y: Stuck after pushing too hard; recognise it and things improve.
hao.nom_na: Like being stuck because you pushed: admit it and things get better.

que_tu.dich: Progress. The powerful prince is honoured with horses in large numbers. In a single day he is granted audience three times.

dai_tuong.dich: The sun rises over the earth: the image of progress; the noble person brightens their own bright virtue.

35.nom_na: Image: the sun rising over the land — brightness spreading. In plain terms: like being recognised and promoted: advance through real ability and good character.

thoan.dich: Progress means advancing. Brightness rises over the earth; devoted and clinging to the great light, the yielding advances and rises. So the powerful prince is honoured with many horses and in a single day is granted audience three times.

hao.dich: Progressing, but turned back. Perseverance brings good fortune. If one meets with no confidence, one should remain calm. No mistake.
hao.y: Blocked at first; stay steady and calm.
hao.nom_na: Like your first proposal being rejected: keep calm and keep going.

hao.dich: Progressing, but in sorrow. Perseverance brings good fortune. Then one obtains great happiness from one's ancestress.
hao.y: Progress with worry, but support comes.
hao.nom_na: Like moving forward while anxious: help comes from a caring elder.

hao.dich: All are in accord. Remorse disappears.
hao.y: With everyone's support, regret falls away.
hao.nom_na: Like having the whole team behind you: good.

hao.dich: Progress like a hamster. Perseverance brings danger.
hao.y: Advancing by greed and stealth is dangerous.
hao.nom_na: Like climbing by grabbing things on the sly: risky.

hao.dich: Remorse disappears. Take not gain and loss to heart. Undertakings bring good fortune. Everything serves to further.
hao.y: Do not worry about gain or loss; go ahead.
hao.nom_na: Like doing your best without counting wins and losses: things go well.

hao.dich: Making progress with the horns is permissible only for the purpose of punishing one's own city. To be conscious of danger brings good fortune. No blame. Perseverance brings humiliation.
hao.y: Use force only to correct your own side.
hao.nom_na: Like using your authority only to fix your own team's mistakes: acceptable, with care.

que_tu.dich: Darkening of the Light. In adversity it furthers one to be persevering.

dai_tuong.dich: The light has sunk into the earth: the image of darkening of the light; the noble person lives with the great mass: veiling their light, yet still shining.

36.nom_na: Image: the sun sinking below the earth — a dark time. In plain terms: like being in an unfair environment: keep your principles quietly, protect yourself, and wait for the light to return.

thoan.dich: The light has sunk into the earth: darkening of the light. Inwardly clear and refined, outwardly yielding and devoted, one bears great adversity — King Wen did so. In adversity it furthers to be persevering: veiling one's light. Facing difficulty within and keeping one's will upright — Prince Ji did so.

hao.dich: Darkening of the light during flight. He lowers his wings. The noble person does not eat for three days on his wanderings. But he has somewhere to go. The host has occasion to gossip about him.
hao.y: Withdraw quickly, even at a cost, and accept the talk.
hao.nom_na: Like leaving a bad workplace quickly: some hardship and gossip, but right.

hao.dich: Darkening of the light injures him in the left thigh. He gives aid with the strength of a horse. Good fortune.
hao.y: Hurt but not beaten; help others with strength.
hao.nom_na: Like being wounded by events but still helping others: good fortune.

hao.dich: Darkening of the light during the hunt in the south. Their great leader is captured. One must not expect perseverance too soon.
hao.y: The source of trouble is found, but change takes time.
hao.nom_na: Like finally finding the cause of a problem: do not expect it fixed overnight.

hao.dich: He penetrates the left side of the belly. One gets at the very heart of the darkening of the light, and leaves gate and courtyard.
hao.y: You understand the situation fully; leave in time.
hao.nom_na: Like seeing exactly how bad things are inside: time to go.

hao.dich: Darkening of the light as with Prince Ji. Perseverance furthers.
hao.y: Hide your light to stay true in a hard place.
hao.nom_na: Like staying quietly principled where you cannot speak out: it is right.

hao.dich: Not light but darkness. First he climbed up to heaven, then he plunged into the depths of the earth.
hao.y: What rose by darkness falls by it.
hao.nom_na: Like someone who rose by wrongdoing: in the end they fall.

que_tu.dich: The Family. The perseverance of the woman furthers.

dai_tuong.dich: Wind comes forth from fire: the image of the family; the noble person has substance in their words and duration in their way of life.

37.nom_na: Image: wind rising from fire — warmth spreading from the hearth. In plain terms: like a home where everyone knows their role and words match deeds: warm, ordered and steady.

thoan.dich: The family: the woman has her right place within, the man has his right place without; that man and woman are in their right places is the great meaning of heaven and earth. The family has firm leaders — they are the parents. When the father is a father, the son a son, the elder brother an elder brother, the younger a younger, the husband a husband and the wife a wife, the way of the family is right; when the family is put right, the world is set in order.

hao.dich: Firm seclusion within the family. Remorse disappears.
hao.y: Clear rules from the start prevent regret.
hao.nom_na: Like setting house rules at the start: fewer problems later.

hao.dich: She should not follow her whims. She must attend within to the food. Perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Taking care of the home's daily needs is valuable.
hao.nom_na: Like the one who keeps the household running day to day: good fortune.

hao.dich: When tempers flare up in the family, too great severity brings remorse. Good fortune nonetheless. When woman and child dally and laugh, it leads in the end to humiliation.
hao.y: Too strict is better than too loose, but balance matters.
hao.nom_na: Like a home that is a bit strict: some friction, but better than anything goes.

hao.dich: She is the treasure of the house. Great good fortune.
hao.y: Caring well for the home brings prosperity.
hao.nom_na: Like a well-managed household: great good fortune.

hao.dich: As a king he approaches his family. Fear not. Good fortune.
hao.y: Lead the family with love, not fear.
hao.nom_na: Like a parent who leads through warmth: good fortune.

hao.dich: His work commands respect. In the end good fortune comes.
hao.y: Sincerity and dignity keep the family good.
hao.nom_na: Like an elder respected for their example: good in the end.

que_tu.dich: Opposition. In small matters, good fortune.

dai_tuong.dich: Above, fire; below, the lake: the image of opposition; amid all fellowship the noble person retains their individuality.

38.nom_na: Image: fire rising, the lake sinking — two forces moving apart. In plain terms: like two people under one roof with different aims: accept the differences and work together on small things.

thoan.dich: Opposition: fire moves upwards, the lake moves downwards; two daughters live together but their wills do not go the same way. Joyful and clinging to clarity, the yielding advances and rises, holds the centre and responds to the firm; so in small matters there is good fortune. Heaven and earth are opposite, yet their work is the same; man and woman are opposite, yet their wills meet; all things are opposite, yet their actions are alike. Great indeed is the use of the time of opposition!

hao.dich: Remorse disappears. If you lose your horse, do not run after it; it will come back of its own accord. When you see evil people, guard yourself against mistakes.
hao.y: Do not chase what has gone; it returns. Stay polite with difficult people.
hao.nom_na: Like a friendship that cooled: let it be, it may come back; be civil with people you dislike.

hao.dich: One meets his lord in a narrow street. No blame.
hao.y: An informal meeting resolves the disagreement.
hao.nom_na: Like settling a dispute over a chance coffee: no blame.

hao.dich: One sees the wagon dragged back, the oxen halted, a man's hair and nose cut off. Not a good beginning, but a good end.
hao.y: A rough start, but things come right in the end.
hao.nom_na: Like a terrible first meeting that later becomes a good relationship.

hao.dich: Isolated through opposition, one meets a like-minded man with whom one can associate in good faith. Despite the danger, no blame.
hao.y: Alone, you find someone you can trust.
hao.nom_na: Like feeling isolated and then finding a true ally.

hao.dich: Remorse disappears. The companion bites his way through the wrappings. If one goes to him, how could it be a mistake?
hao.y: A close ally breaks through the barrier; go to them.
hao.nom_na: Like a friend who makes the first move to reconcile: meet them.

hao.dich: Isolated through opposition, one sees one's companion as a pig covered with dirt, as a wagon full of devils. First one draws a bow against him, then one lays the bow aside. He is not a robber; he will woo at the right time. As one goes, rain falls; then good fortune comes.
hao.y: Suspicion distorts what you see; once it lifts, there is reconciliation.
hao.nom_na: Like imagining the worst about someone, then realising you were wrong: relief and good fortune.

que_tu.dich: Obstruction. The south-west furthers. The north-east does not further. It furthers one to see the great person. Perseverance brings good fortune.

dai_tuong.dich: Water on the mountain: the image of obstruction; the noble person turns their attention to themselves and moulds their character.

39.nom_na: Image: water on a steep mountain — a hard climb in every direction. In plain terms: like a project that is stuck: stop, look at your own part in it, find someone to help, and take the safer way round.

thoan.dich: Obstruction means difficulty: danger lies ahead. To see danger and know how to stop — that is wisdom! The south-west furthers: going there one reaches the centre. The north-east does not further: that way comes to an end. It furthers to see the great person: going brings achievement. Being in the proper place, perseverance brings good fortune and sets the country right. Great indeed is the use of the time of obstruction!

hao.dich: Going leads to obstructions, coming meets with praise.
hao.y: Waiting is better than pushing on.
hao.nom_na: Like holding back instead of forcing ahead: you are praised for it.

hao.dich: The king's servant is beset by obstruction upon obstruction, but it is not his own fault.
hao.y: Facing obstacles in someone else's service is no fault of yours.
hao.nom_na: Like dealing with problems because of your job, not your own mistakes.

hao.dich: Going leads to obstructions; hence he comes back.
hao.y: Turn back to those who need you.
hao.nom_na: Like returning to your family when the road ahead is blocked.

hao.dich: Going leads to obstructions, coming leads to union.
hao.y: Wait and join with others first.
hao.nom_na: Like waiting to build a coalition before acting.

hao.dich: In the midst of the greatest obstructions, friends come.
hao.y: In the hardest moment, help arrives.
hao.nom_na: Like friends showing up when things are at their worst.

hao.dich: Going leads to obstructions, coming leads to great good fortune. It furthers one to see the great person.
hao.y: Come back and help; seek wise guidance.
hao.nom_na: Like an experienced person returning to help others through: great good fortune.

que_tu.dich: Deliverance. The south-west furthers. If there is no longer anything where one has to go, return brings good fortune. If there is still something where one has to go, hastening brings good fortune.

dai_tuong.dich: Thunder and rain set in: the image of deliverance; the noble person pardons mistakes and forgives misdeeds.

40.nom_na: Image: thunder and a storm breaking — the tension finally releases. In plain terms: like the moment a problem is finally solved: settle the rest quickly, forgive, and get back to normal.

thoan.dich: Deliverance: danger and movement — moving, one escapes danger: deliverance. The south-west furthers: going, one wins the people. Return brings good fortune: one reaches the centre. If there is still somewhere to go, hastening brings good fortune: going brings achievement. Heaven and earth are delivered and thunder and rain set in; when thunder and rain set in, the buds of fruit trees and plants all burst open. Great indeed is the time of deliverance!

hao.dich: Without blame.
hao.y: The trouble is over; rest.
hao.nom_na: Like the first quiet day after a crisis: no blame.

hao.dich: One kills three foxes in the field and receives a yellow arrow. Perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Removing the hidden troublemakers with fairness.
hao.nom_na: Like clearing out the hidden causes of a problem fairly: good fortune.

hao.dich: If a man carries a burden on his back and nonetheless rides in a carriage, he thereby encourages robbers to draw near. Perseverance leads to humiliation.
hao.y: Taking a position you have not earned invites trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like showing off a status you do not have: it attracts problems.

hao.dich: Deliver yourself from your great toe. Then the companion comes, and him you can trust.
hao.y: Let go of the wrong attachments so true friends can come.
hao.nom_na: Like letting go of a bad influence so real friends can come close.

hao.dich: If only the noble person can deliver himself, it brings good fortune. Thus he proves to inferior people that he is in earnest.
hao.y: Free yourself first; others will see you mean it.
hao.nom_na: Like breaking a bad habit yourself: others take you seriously.

hao.dich: The prince shoots at a hawk on a high wall. He kills it. Everything serves to further.
hao.y: Remove the last obstacle decisively at the right time.
hao.nom_na: Like dealing with the final problem at the right moment: everything clears.

que_tu.dich: Decrease combined with sincerity brings supreme good fortune without blame. One may be persevering in this. It furthers one to undertake something. How is this to be carried out? One may use two small bowls for the offering.

dai_tuong.dich: At the foot of the mountain, the lake: the image of decrease; the noble person controls their anger and restrains their desires.

41.nom_na: Image: a lake at the foot of a mountain — the lake gives up water so the mountain stays green. In plain terms: like cutting back on purpose: drop the excess, hold back anger and wants, and give where it matters — sincerity counts more than size.

thoan.dich: Decrease: what is below is decreased and what is above is increased; the way goes upward. Decrease with sincerity brings supreme good fortune without blame; one may persevere and it furthers to undertake something. How is it to be carried out? Two small bowls may be used for the offering — two bowls must suit the time. Decreasing the firm and increasing the yielding has its time; decrease and increase, filling and emptying, go together with the time.

hao.dich: Going quickly when one's tasks are finished is without blame. But one must reflect on how much one may decrease others.
hao.y: Help others, but think about how much you can give.
hao.nom_na: Like helping a friend after your own work is done: good, but do not overdo it.

hao.dich: Perseverance furthers. To undertake something brings misfortune. Without decreasing oneself, one is able to bring increase to others.
hao.y: Help others without losing yourself.
hao.nom_na: Like supporting others while keeping your own footing: that is real help.

hao.dich: When three people journey together, their number decreases by one. When one person journeys alone, they find a companion.
hao.y: Too many spoil the bond; alone, you find a true partner.
hao.nom_na: Like a three-way partnership that becomes two: sometimes fewer is better.

hao.dich: If a person decreases their faults, it makes the other hasten to come and rejoice. No blame.
hao.y: Fixing your own flaws brings people closer.
hao.nom_na: Like dropping a bad habit: friends come back gladly.

hao.dich: Someone does indeed increase him. Ten pairs of tortoises cannot oppose it. Supreme good fortune.
hao.y: Blessings come that nothing can stop.
hao.nom_na: Like unexpected support that nothing can prevent: great good fortune.

hao.dich: If one is increased without depriving others, there is no blame. Perseverance brings good fortune. It furthers one to undertake something. One obtains servants but no longer has a separate home.
hao.y: Gaining while also benefiting others; serve the wider good.
hao.nom_na: Like a leader who grows by helping everyone: good fortune.

que_tu.dich: Increase. It furthers one to undertake something. It furthers one to cross the great water.

dai_tuong.dich: Wind and thunder: the image of increase; when the noble person sees good, they imitate it; when they have faults, they rid themselves of them.

42.nom_na: Image: wind and thunder strengthening each other. In plain terms: like a time of growth and support: seize it, help others rise with you, follow good examples and correct your mistakes.

thoan.dich: Increase: what is above is decreased and what is below is increased; the people rejoice without limit. Coming down from above to those below, its way is greatly bright. It furthers to undertake something: central and correct, there is blessing. It furthers to cross the great water: the way of wood moves. Increase moves gently and advances day by day without limit. Heaven gives and earth brings forth; its increase has no bounds. The way of increase always goes together with the time.

hao.dich: It furthers one to accomplish great deeds. Supreme good fortune. No blame.
hao.y: With support, take on something great.
hao.nom_na: Like being given resources for a big project: use them well.

hao.dich: Someone does indeed increase him; ten pairs of tortoises cannot oppose it. Constant perseverance brings good fortune. The king presents him before God. Good fortune.
hao.y: Blessings come; stay steady.
hao.nom_na: Like support arriving from all sides: keep your feet on the ground.

hao.dich: One is enriched through unfortunate events. No blame, if you are sincere and walk in the middle, and report with a seal to the prince.
hao.y: Even hard events can bring benefit if you stay honest.
hao.nom_na: Like gaining experience from a crisis: stay honest and transparent.

hao.dich: If you walk in the middle and report to the prince, he will follow. It furthers one to be used in the removal of the capital.
hao.y: A fair voice is listened to in big changes.
hao.nom_na: Like being trusted to advise on a major move: be balanced.

hao.dich: If in truth you have a kind heart, ask not. Supreme good fortune. Truly, kindness will be recognised as your virtue.
hao.y: Sincere kindness needs no asking; it is recognised.
hao.nom_na: Like helping without being asked: people remember.

hao.dich: He brings increase to no one. Indeed, someone even strikes him. He does not keep his heart constantly steady. Misfortune.
hao.y: Taking without giving brings attack.
hao.nom_na: Like grabbing for yourself and never sharing: people turn against you.

que_tu.dich: Breakthrough. One must resolutely make the matter known at the court of the king. It must be announced truthfully. Danger. It is necessary to notify one's own city. It does not further to resort to arms. It furthers one to undertake something.

dai_tuong.dich: The lake has risen up to heaven: the image of breakthrough; the noble person dispenses riches downward and refrains from resting on their virtue.

43.nom_na: Image: lake water risen to the sky — pressure that must break through. In plain terms: like a decision you have already made in your heart: announce it openly and honestly, decisively but without force.

thoan.dich: Breakthrough means resolution: the firm resolves the yielding. Strong and joyful, resolute and harmonious. One must make the matter known at the king's court: one yielding line rides on five firm ones. Announcing it truthfully, there is danger — the danger brings light. Notifying one's own city, it does not further to resort to arms: what is valued would be exhausted. It furthers to undertake something: the firm grows and the matter is concluded.

hao.dich: Mighty in the forward-striding toes. When one goes and is not equal to the task, one makes a mistake.
hao.y: Pushing ahead before you are ready is a mistake.
hao.nom_na: Like announcing a big change before you are prepared: it fails.

hao.dich: A cry of alarm. Arms at evening and at night. Fear nothing.
hao.y: Stay alert and prepared; then there is nothing to fear.
hao.nom_na: Like keeping watch during a tense time: prepared, you need not worry.

hao.dich: To be powerful in the cheekbones brings misfortune. The noble person is firmly resolved. He walks alone and is caught in the rain. He is bespattered, and people murmur against him. No blame.
hao.y: Act firmly, even if alone and misunderstood.
hao.nom_na: Like doing the right thing alone and being criticised: no blame in the end.

hao.dich: There is no skin on his thighs, and walking comes hard. If a man would let himself be led like a sheep, remorse would disappear. But if these words are heard they will not be believed.
hao.y: Restless and stubborn; letting others lead would help.
hao.nom_na: Like refusing good advice out of pride: listen and things would ease.

hao.dich: In dealing with weeds, firm resolution is necessary. Walking in the middle remains free of blame.
hao.y: Clear away the problem firmly, but fairly.
hao.nom_na: Like weeding a garden: be thorough but balanced.

hao.dich: No cry. In the end misfortune comes.
hao.y: Ignoring the warning signs leads to trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like no one sounding the alarm: trouble arrives in the end.

que_tu.dich: Coming to Meet. The maiden is powerful. One should not marry such a maiden.

dai_tuong.dich: Under heaven, wind: the image of coming to meet; the prince acts when disseminating his commands and proclaiming them to the four quarters of heaven.

44.nom_na: Image: wind blowing under the sky — reaching everywhere, meeting everything. In plain terms: like an unexpected meeting or opportunity: it can grow fast, so check it carefully before letting it in.

thoan.dich: Coming to meet means encountering: the yielding meets the firm. One should not marry such a maiden: one cannot live with her long. Heaven and earth meet and all things are revealed. The firm meets the central and correct, and its way spreads through the world. Great indeed is the meaning of the time of coming to meet!

hao.dich: It must be checked with a brake of bronze. Perseverance brings good fortune. If one lets it take its course, one experiences misfortune. Even a lean pig has it in him to rage around.
hao.y: Stop a small bad influence early.
hao.nom_na: Like curbing a small bad habit before it grows: good.

hao.dich: There is a fish in the tank. No blame. Does not further guests.
hao.y: Keep the matter contained; do not spread it.
hao.nom_na: Like handling a problem quietly in-house: no blame.

hao.dich: There is no skin on his thighs, and walking comes hard. If one is mindful of the danger, no great mistake is made.
hao.y: Uneasy and hesitant; staying careful avoids big mistakes.
hao.nom_na: Like being unsure whether to go ahead: careful, you avoid harm.

hao.dich: No fish in the tank. This leads to misfortune.
hao.y: Losing touch with your people brings trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like a leader who has lost the support of their team.

hao.dich: A melon covered with willow leaves. Hidden lines. Then it drops down to one from heaven.
hao.y: Quality hidden inside will show in time.
hao.nom_na: Like real talent kept modest: it is recognised in the end.

hao.dich: He comes to meet with his horns. Humiliation. No blame.
hao.y: Meeting things with hostility isolates you, but it is not a fault.
hao.nom_na: Like meeting others with a cold shoulder: lonely, but not wrong.

que_tu.dich: Gathering Together. Success. The king approaches his temple. It furthers one to see the great person. This brings success. Perseverance furthers. To bring great offerings creates good fortune. It furthers one to undertake something.

dai_tuong.dich: Over the earth, the lake: the image of gathering together; the noble person renews their weapons in order to meet the unforeseen.

45.nom_na: Image: a lake collecting water over the land — many coming together. In plain terms: like a reunion or a big meeting: gather people around a shared goal, with a leader, and be ready for the unexpected.

thoan.dich: Gathering together means assembling. Devoted and joyful, firm in the centre and met with response — so there is gathering. The king approaches his temple to make offerings with filial piety. It furthers to see the great person, success: gathering in what is right. Great offerings bring good fortune and it furthers to undertake something: following the will of heaven. Look at what gathers things, and the nature of heaven, earth and all beings can be seen.

hao.dich: If you are sincere, but not to the end, there will sometimes be confusion, sometimes gathering together. If you call out, then after one grasp of the hand you can laugh again. Regret not. Going is without blame.
hao.y: Unsure at first; once you reach out, it turns to joy.
hao.nom_na: Like hesitating to join a group, then being welcomed warmly.

hao.dich: Letting oneself be drawn brings good fortune and remains blameless. If one is sincere, it furthers one to bring even a small offering.
hao.y: Being drawn in sincerely is good; a small gesture is enough.
hao.nom_na: Like joining because you were invited: a simple, sincere gift is enough.

hao.dich: Gathering together amid sighs. Nothing that would further. Going is without blame. Slight humiliation.
hao.y: Feeling left out; reach out anyway.
hao.nom_na: Like feeling on the edge of a group: go and join — a little awkward, but fine.

hao.dich: Great good fortune. No blame.
hao.y: Working for the common good brings great fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like bringing everyone together for a good cause: great fortune.

hao.dich: If in gathering together one has position, this brings no blame. If there are some who are not yet sincerely in the work, sublime and enduring perseverance is needed. Then remorse disappears.
hao.y: You have the position; earn the trust with steady integrity.
hao.nom_na: Like a new leader whom not everyone trusts yet: steady integrity wins them over.

hao.dich: Lamenting and sighing, floods of tears. No blame.
hao.y: Sorrow at being apart, but sincere.
hao.nom_na: Like grieving being left out: no blame.

que_tu.dich: Pushing Upward has supreme success. One must see the great person. Fear not. Departure toward the south brings good fortune.

dai_tuong.dich: Within the earth, wood grows: the image of pushing upward; the noble person of devoted character heaps up small things in order to achieve something high and great.

46.nom_na: Image: a tree growing up out of the earth — steady growth from small to tall. In plain terms: like a career that rises step by step: keep climbing steadily, with the help of respected people.

thoan.dich: The yielding pushes upward with the time; gentle and devoted, firm in the centre and met with response — so there is great success. One must see the great person; fear not: there will be blessing. Departure toward the south brings good fortune: the will is carried out.

hao.dich: Pushing upward that meets with confidence brings great good fortune.
hao.y: Rising with others' trust brings great fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like being welcomed into a new position: very good.

hao.dich: If one is sincere, it furthers one to bring even a small offering. No blame.
hao.y: Sincerity matters more than show.
hao.nom_na: Like a simple, honest effort that is appreciated: no blame.

hao.dich: One pushes upward into an empty city.
hao.y: The way ahead is open, with no resistance.
hao.nom_na: Like entering a market with no competition: smooth progress.

hao.dich: The king offers him Mount Qi. Good fortune. No blame.
hao.y: Being honoured for your merit.
hao.nom_na: Like being given recognition for loyal work: good.

hao.dich: Perseverance brings good fortune. One pushes upward by steps.
hao.y: Rise step by step, steadily.
hao.nom_na: Like a promotion earned rung by rung: good.

hao.dich: Pushing upward in darkness. It furthers one to be unremittingly persevering.
hao.y: Climbing blindly; only steady effort helps.
hao.nom_na: Like pushing for more without seeing where it leads: only careful persistence helps.

que_tu.dich: Oppression. Success. Perseverance. The great person brings about good fortune. No blame. When one has something to say, it is not believed.

dai_tuong.dich: There is no water in the lake: the image of exhaustion; the noble person stakes their life on following their will.

47.nom_na: Image: a lake with its water drained away — dried up and hemmed in. In plain terms: like a time when resources run out and no one listens: keep your resolve, talk less, and let your actions speak.

thoan.dich: Oppression: the firm is covered over. In danger and yet joyful, oppressed yet not losing one's place — success; who but the noble person can do this? Perseverance — the great person brings good fortune, because they are firm and central. When one has something to say it is not believed: relying on words leads to dead ends.

hao.dich: One sits oppressed under a bare tree and strays into a gloomy valley. For three years one sees nothing.
hao.y: Sinking into gloom makes things worse.
hao.nom_na: Like brooding in a hard time: you see no way out for a long while.

hao.dich: One is oppressed while at meat and drink. The man with the scarlet knee bands is just coming. It furthers one to offer sacrifice. To set forth brings misfortune. No blame.
hao.y: Burdened even amid plenty; help is coming, wait for it.
hao.nom_na: Like feeling stuck despite comfort: wait for the help that is on its way.

hao.dich: A man permits himself to be oppressed by stone, and leans on thorns and thistles. He enters his house and does not see his wife. Misfortune.
hao.y: Fighting the wrong battles leaves you without support.
hao.nom_na: Like pushing against what cannot move and losing your support at home.

hao.dich: He comes very quietly, oppressed in a golden carriage. Humiliation, but the end is reached.
hao.y: Slow to help because of hesitation, but it gets there.
hao.nom_na: Like help that arrives late but still arrives.

hao.dich: His nose and feet are cut off. Oppression at the hands of the man with the purple knee bands. Joy comes softly. It furthers one to make offerings and libations.
hao.y: Pressure from above eases slowly; stay sincere.
hao.nom_na: Like being squeezed by those above you: relief comes gradually.

hao.dich: He is oppressed by creeping vines. He moves uncertainly and says, 'Movement brings remorse.' If one feels remorse over this and makes a start, good fortune comes.
hao.y: Fear of acting keeps you stuck; acting brings relief.
hao.nom_na: Like being trapped by your own worry: once you move, things get better.

que_tu.dich: The Well. The town may be changed, but the well cannot be changed. It neither decreases nor increases. They come and go and draw from the well. If one gets down almost to the water and the rope does not go all the way, or the jug breaks, it brings misfortune.

dai_tuong.dich: Water over wood: the image of the well; the noble person encourages the people at their work and exhorts them to help one another.

48.nom_na: Image: water drawn up by a wooden bucket — a source that feeds everyone. In plain terms: like the core resources of a home or business: look after the source and see the job through to the last step.

thoan.dich: Going down into the water and bringing water up — that is the well. The well nourishes without being exhausted. The town may be changed but not the well: because of firmness in the centre. Getting almost to the water but the rope not reaching: no achievement yet. The jug breaks: hence misfortune.

hao.dich: One does not drink the mud of the well. No animals come to an old well.
hao.y: A neglected source is useless.
hao.nom_na: Like skills you have let lapse: no one comes to you for them.

hao.dich: At the wellhole one shoots fishes. The jug is broken and leaks.
hao.y: Wasting a good resource on small things.
hao.nom_na: Like using a talent for trivial things: it is wasted.

hao.dich: The well is cleaned, but no one drinks from it. This is my heart's sorrow, for one might draw from it. If the king were clear-minded, good fortune might be enjoyed in common.
hao.y: Ready and capable, but not yet used.
hao.nom_na: Like a qualified person who is overlooked: it will be valued in time.

hao.dich: The well is being lined. No blame.
hao.y: Repairing and improving yourself is right.
hao.nom_na: Like taking time to train and improve: no blame.

hao.dich: In the well there is a clear, cold spring from which one can drink.
hao.y: A pure resource is ready to be used.
hao.nom_na: Like a source of real value that others can now benefit from.

hao.dich: One draws from the well without hindrance. It is dependable. Supreme good fortune.
hao.y: A reliable source open to all brings great fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like sharing freely what you have: great good fortune.

que_tu.dich: Revolution. On your own day you are believed. Supreme success, furthering through perseverance. Remorse disappears.

dai_tuong.dich: Fire in the lake: the image of revolution; the noble person sets the calendar in order and makes the seasons clear.

49.nom_na: Image: fire inside the lake — two forces that cannot stay as they are. In plain terms: like a reorganisation or a big change in your life: change when the time is ripe and people trust you, and prepare it well.

thoan.dich: Revolution: water and fire extinguish each other; two daughters live together but their wills cannot agree — this is called revolution. On your own day you are believed: change, and then you are trusted. Clear and refined, and joyful; great success through what is right. When change is fitting, remorse disappears. Heaven and earth change and the four seasons are completed; Tang and Wu changed the mandate, in accord with heaven and in response to the people. Great indeed is the time of revolution!

hao.dich: Wrapped in the hide of a yellow cow.
hao.y: Not yet time to change; hold steady.
hao.nom_na: Like wanting change before conditions are ready: hold firm for now.

hao.dich: When one's own day comes, one may create revolution. Starting brings good fortune. No blame.
hao.y: The time is right to change; go ahead.
hao.nom_na: Like the moment a change becomes clearly needed: act.

hao.dich: Starting brings misfortune. Perseverance brings danger. When talk of revolution has gone the rounds three times, one may commit oneself, and people will believe.
hao.y: Do not rush; discuss the change thoroughly first.
hao.nom_na: Like consulting everyone before a reform: then people back it.

hao.dich: Remorse disappears. Men believe him. Changing the form of government brings good fortune.
hao.y: A trusted change brings good fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like a reform people believe in: it succeeds.

hao.dich: The great person changes like a tiger. Even before he questions the oracle he is believed.
hao.y: A clear, bold change by a respected leader.
hao.nom_na: Like a leader whose big change is trusted at once.

hao.dich: The noble person changes like a panther. The inferior person molts in the face. Starting brings misfortune. To remain persevering brings good fortune.
hao.y: The change is done; settle in and do not push further.
hao.nom_na: Like after a reform: consolidate rather than start new upheavals.

que_tu.dich: The Cauldron. Supreme good fortune. Success.

dai_tuong.dich: Fire over wood: the image of the cauldron; the noble person consolidates their fate by making their position correct.

50.nom_na: Image: fire under a cooking pot — turning raw things into nourishment. In plain terms: like building something lasting and putting the right people in the right roles: stabilise the new and nurture talent.

thoan.dich: The cauldron is an image: wood fed to the fire, cooking food. The sage cooks to make offerings to the Supreme Deity, and cooks on a great scale to nourish the sages and the worthy. Gentle, with clear ears and eyes; the yielding advances and rises, holds the centre and responds to the firm — so there is supreme success.

hao.dich: A cauldron with legs upturned. Furthers removal of stagnating stuff. One takes a concubine for the sake of her son. No blame.
hao.y: Clearing out the old makes room for the new.
hao.nom_na: Like emptying out old habits before starting fresh: no blame.

hao.dich: There is food in the cauldron. My comrades are envious, but they cannot harm me. Good fortune.
hao.y: You have real substance; envy cannot hurt you.
hao.nom_na: Like having real ability when others are jealous: you are fine.

hao.dich: The handle of the cauldron is altered. One is impeded in his way of life. The fat of the pheasant is not eaten. Once rain falls, remorse is spent. Good fortune comes in the end.
hao.y: Your talent is not used yet; it will come right.
hao.nom_na: Like being overlooked for now: in time you are recognised.

hao.dich: The legs of the cauldron are broken. The prince's meal is spilled and his person is soiled. Misfortune.
hao.y: Taking on more than you can carry ends badly.
hao.nom_na: Like accepting a role too big for you: things spill over.

hao.dich: The cauldron has yellow handles, golden carrying rings. Perseverance furthers.
hao.y: Balanced and capable; stay steady.
hao.nom_na: Like a well-run team with a fair leader: good.

hao.dich: The cauldron has carrying rings of jade. Great good fortune. Nothing that would not act to further.
hao.y: Firm yet gentle, it all works out.
hao.nom_na: Like a project led with strength and kindness: great good fortune.

que_tu.dich: The Arousing (shock, thunder) brings success. Shock comes — oh, oh! Laughing words — ha, ha! The shock terrifies for a hundred miles, and he does not let fall the sacrificial spoon and chalice.

dai_tuong.dich: Thunder repeated: the image of shock; in fear and trembling the noble person sets their life in order and examines themselves.

51.nom_na: Image: thunder upon thunder — shock after shock. In plain terms: like sudden upheaval at home or at work: it frightens at first, but if you stay calm and take stock of yourself, you come out of it laughing.

thoan.dich: Shock brings success. Shock comes — oh, oh: fear brings good fortune. Laughing words — ha, ha: afterwards there is order. The shock terrifies for a hundred miles: it startles the distant and frightens the near. One who can stay calm can guard the ancestral temple and the altars and be master of the offering.

hao.dich: Shock comes — oh, oh! Then follow laughing words — ha, ha! Good fortune.
hao.y: Fear at first, relief afterwards.
hao.nom_na: Like a scare that turns out fine: you laugh about it later.

hao.dich: Shock comes bringing danger. A hundred thousand times you lose your treasures and must climb the nine hills. Do not go in pursuit of them. After seven days you will get them back again.
hao.y: Losses in a shock; do not chase them, they return.
hao.nom_na: Like losing money in a sudden crash: do not panic-chase it; things recover.

hao.dich: Shock comes and makes one distraught. If shock spurs to action, one remains free of misfortune.
hao.y: Use the shock to act sensibly.
hao.nom_na: Like turning a scare into a wake-up call: no harm.

hao.dich: Shock is mired.
hao.y: Paralysed by the shock.
hao.nom_na: Like freezing in a crisis: stuck.

hao.dich: Shock goes hither and thither. Danger. However, nothing at all is lost. Yet there are things to be done.
hao.y: Repeated shocks, but you hold your ground.
hao.nom_na: Like wave after wave of trouble: nothing lost if you stay at your post.

hao.dich: Shock brings ruin and terrified gazing around. Going ahead brings misfortune. If it has not yet touched one's own body but has reached one's neighbour first, there is no blame. One's comrades have something to talk about.
hao.y: Learn from others' troubles and stay calm.
hao.nom_na: Like seeing a crisis hit someone else first: stay calm and prepare.

que_tu.dich: Keeping Still. Keeping his back still so that he no longer feels his body. He goes into his courtyard and does not see his people. No blame.

dai_tuong.dich: Mountains standing close together: the image of keeping still; the noble person does not permit their thoughts to go beyond their situation.

52.nom_na: Image: mountain upon mountain — complete stillness. In plain terms: like pressing pause: stop at the right moment, calm your mind, and think within your own place before taking the next step.

thoan.dich: Keeping still means stopping. When it is time to stop, stop; when it is time to move, move. When movement and rest each come at the right time, the way is bright and clear. Keeping still in stopping means stopping in one's proper place. Above and below are opposed and do not meet. So he no longer feels his body, goes into his courtyard and does not see his people — no blame.

hao.dich: Keeping his toes still. No blame. Continued perseverance furthers.
hao.y: Stop before you start in the wrong direction.
hao.nom_na: Like pausing before your first step: no blame.

hao.dich: Keeping his calves still. He cannot rescue him whom he follows. His heart is not glad.
hao.y: You cannot stop what you are following; frustrating.
hao.nom_na: Like being swept along by others' decisions: you feel uneasy.

hao.dich: Keeping his hips still. Making his sacrum stiff. Dangerous. The heart suffocates.
hao.y: Forcing yourself to be still makes it worse.
hao.nom_na: Like suppressing everything by force: the stress builds.

hao.dich: Keeping his trunk still. No blame.
hao.y: Calming yourself is right.
hao.nom_na: Like taking time to calm your own mind: good.

hao.dich: Keeping his jaws still. The words have order. Remorse disappears.
hao.y: Careful speech prevents regret.
hao.nom_na: Like thinking before speaking: fewer regrets.

hao.dich: Noblehearted keeping still. Good fortune.
hao.y: Deep, generous calm brings good fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like a settled, peaceful mind: good fortune.

que_tu.dich: Development. The maiden is given in marriage. Good fortune. Perseverance furthers.

dai_tuong.dich: On the mountain, a tree: the image of development; the noble person abides in dignity and virtue, in order to improve the mores.

53.nom_na: Image: a tree growing slowly on a mountain — rooted, step by step. In plain terms: like a relationship or a career built gradually: follow the proper order and do not skip stages.

thoan.dich: Development is advancing step by step: the maiden given in marriage brings good fortune. Advancing, one gains one's place: going brings achievement. Advancing in the right way, one can set the country right. Its place is firm and central. Still and gentle, its movement does not run out.

hao.dich: The wild goose gradually draws near the shore. The young son is in danger. There is talk. No blame.
hao.y: A risky first step; some criticism, but no fault.
hao.nom_na: Like a beginner taking a first step: some talk, but no harm.

hao.dich: The wild goose gradually draws near the cliff. Eating and drinking in peace and concord. Good fortune.
hao.y: A secure footing; enjoy it.
hao.nom_na: Like settling into a stable job: good.

hao.dich: The wild goose gradually draws near the plateau. The man goes forth and does not return. The woman carries a child but does not bring it forth. Misfortune. It furthers one to fight off robbers.
hao.y: Overstepping leaves things unfinished; protect what you have.
hao.nom_na: Like rushing past the natural pace: things go wrong — guard what matters.

hao.dich: The wild goose goes gradually to the tree. Perhaps it will find a flat branch. No blame.
hao.y: An awkward position, but a safe spot can be found.
hao.nom_na: Like being in an uncomfortable role: find a stable footing.

hao.dich: The wild goose gradually draws near the summit. For three years the woman has no child. In the end nothing can hinder her. Good fortune.
hao.y: A long wait, but in the end it succeeds.
hao.nom_na: Like a goal that takes years: in the end nothing can stop it.

hao.dich: The wild goose gradually draws near the cloud heights. Its feathers can be used for the sacred dance. Good fortune.
hao.y: Having risen high, you become an example.
hao.nom_na: Like someone whose journey inspires others: good fortune.

que_tu.dich: The Marrying Maiden. Undertakings bring misfortune. Nothing that would further.

dai_tuong.dich: Thunder over the lake: the image of the marrying maiden; the noble person understands the transitory in the light of the eternity of the end.

54.nom_na: Image: thunder over the lake — movement driven by feeling. In plain terms: like accepting a lesser position because you are in a hurry: see your place and limits clearly, and do not put yourself at a disadvantage.

thoan.dich: The marrying maiden is the great meaning of heaven and earth. If heaven and earth did not meet, nothing would flourish. The marrying maiden is the end and beginning of humanity. Joyful and moving — that is the marrying maiden. Undertakings bring misfortune: the position is not proper. Nothing furthers: the yielding rides on the firm.

hao.dich: The marrying maiden as a concubine. A lame man who is able to tread. Undertakings bring good fortune.
hao.y: A modest role, but you can still do good.
hao.nom_na: Like a junior role where you can still contribute well.

hao.dich: A one-eyed man who is able to see. The perseverance of a solitary man furthers.
hao.y: Stay loyal and quiet even if your view is limited.
hao.nom_na: Like keeping faith in a situation you cannot fully see: steady.

hao.dich: The marrying maiden as a slave. She marries as a concubine.
hao.y: Accepting a low position out of impatience.
hao.nom_na: Like taking any job out of desperation: it limits you.

hao.dich: The marrying maiden draws out the allotted time. A late marriage comes in due course.
hao.y: Waiting for the right match is worth it.
hao.nom_na: Like waiting for the right offer: it comes in time.

hao.dich: The sovereign I gave his daughter in marriage. The embroidered garments of the princess were not as gorgeous as those of the serving maid. The moon that is nearly full brings good fortune.
hao.y: Modesty in a high position brings good fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like a high-ranking person who dresses simply: respected.

hao.dich: The woman holds the basket, but there are no fruits in it. The man stabs the sheep, but no blood flows. Nothing that acts to further.
hao.y: Going through the motions without substance.
hao.nom_na: Like a commitment that is only for show: nothing comes of it.

que_tu.dich: Abundance has success. The king attains abundance. Be not sad. Be like the sun at midday.

dai_tuong.dich: Both thunder and lightning come: the image of abundance; the noble person decides lawsuits and carries out punishments.

55.nom_na: Image: thunder and lightning together — everything at full brightness. In plain terms: like being at the peak of success: enjoy and share it, and prepare for when the sun begins to set.

thoan.dich: Abundance means greatness. Clarity and movement — so there is abundance. The king attains it: he values greatness. Be not sad, be like the sun at midday: shine on the whole world. When the sun stands at midday it begins to set; when the moon is full it begins to wane. The fullness and emptiness of heaven and earth wax and wane with the time — how much more so for people, how much more for spirits!

hao.dich: When a man meets his destined ruler, they can be together ten days, and it is not a mistake. Going meets with recognition.
hao.y: Meeting the right partner; act together.
hao.nom_na: Like finding the right collaborator: go ahead.

hao.dich: The curtain is of such fullness that the polestars can be seen at noon. Through going one meets with mistrust and hate. If one rouses him through truth, good fortune comes.
hao.y: You are not trusted yet; sincerity wins through.
hao.nom_na: Like being doubted by a boss: honest work wins them over.

hao.dich: The underbrush is of such abundance that the small stars can be seen at noon. He breaks his right arm. No blame.
hao.y: Blocked from acting; it is not your fault.
hao.nom_na: Like being sidelined at the peak: no blame.

hao.dich: The curtain is of such fullness that the polestars can be seen at noon. He meets his ruler, who is of like kind. Good fortune.
hao.y: Finding an equal ally clears the way.
hao.nom_na: Like meeting someone on the same wavelength: good fortune.

hao.dich: Lines are coming. Blessing and fame draw near. Good fortune.
hao.y: Gathering capable people brings blessing.
hao.nom_na: Like bringing talented people into your team: success and praise.

hao.dich: His house is in a state of abundance. He screens off his family. He peers through the gate and no longer perceives anyone. For three years he sees nothing. Misfortune.
hao.y: Shutting yourself away in your wealth leads to isolation.
hao.nom_na: Like a successful person who cuts everyone off: lonely and stuck.

que_tu.dich: The Wanderer. Success through smallness. Perseverance brings good fortune to the wanderer.

dai_tuong.dich: Fire on the mountain: the image of the wanderer; the noble person is clear-minded and cautious in imposing penalties, and protracts no lawsuits.

56.nom_na: Image: fire moving across a mountain — never staying in one place. In plain terms: like working away from home or living somewhere temporary: be careful, modest and travel light.

thoan.dich: The wanderer: success through smallness. The yielding holds the centre on the outside and is devoted to the firm; keeping still and clinging to clarity — so there is success through smallness, and perseverance brings good fortune to the wanderer. Great indeed is the meaning of the time of the wanderer!

hao.dich: If the wanderer busies himself with trivial things, he draws down misfortune upon himself.
hao.y: Fussing over petty things abroad brings trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like squabbling over small things in a new place: it causes problems.

hao.dich: The wanderer comes to an inn. He has his property with him. He wins the steadfastness of a young servant.
hao.y: A safe place and trusted help.
hao.nom_na: Like finding good lodgings and a reliable helper while away: good.

hao.dich: The wanderer's inn burns down. He loses the steadfastness of his young servant. Danger.
hao.y: Arrogance abroad loses you your support.
hao.nom_na: Like being rude in a foreign place and losing your helpers: risky.

hao.dich: The wanderer rests in a shelter. He obtains his property and an axe. My heart is not glad.
hao.y: Secure but unsettled.
hao.nom_na: Like having what you need but not feeling at home.

hao.dich: He shoots a pheasant. It drops with the first arrow. In the end this brings both praise and office.
hao.y: A small effort well placed brings recognition.
hao.nom_na: Like one good contribution that earns you a place.

hao.dich: The bird's nest burns up. The wanderer laughs at first, then must needs lament and weep. Through carelessness he loses his cow. Misfortune.
hao.y: Carelessness and pride lose you your base.
hao.nom_na: Like laughing off risks while away and then losing everything.

que_tu.dich: The Gentle. Success through what is small. It furthers one to have somewhere to go. It furthers one to see the great person.

dai_tuong.dich: Winds following one upon the other: the image of the gently penetrating; the noble person spreads their commands abroad and carries out their undertakings.

57.nom_na: Image: wind following wind — gentle, but getting in everywhere. In plain terms: like persuading people or changing a habit: act gently, steadily and repeatedly, and understand before you act.

thoan.dich: The doubled gentle serves to repeat commands. The firm penetrates into what is central and correct and its will is carried out. The yielding all comply with the firm; so there is success through what is small, it furthers to have somewhere to go, and it furthers to see the great person.

hao.dich: In advancing and in retreating, the perseverance of a warrior furthers.
hao.y: Indecision is cured by firm discipline.
hao.nom_na: Like going back and forth on a decision: pick one and commit like a soldier.

hao.dich: Penetration under the bed. Priests and magicians are used in great number. Good fortune. No blame.
hao.y: Search out the hidden cause thoroughly.
hao.nom_na: Like getting to the bottom of a hidden problem with expert help: good.

hao.dich: Repeated penetration. Humiliation.
hao.y: Overthinking and hesitating repeatedly brings regret.
hao.nom_na: Like changing your mind again and again: embarrassing.

hao.dich: Remorse vanishes. During the hunt three kinds of game are caught.
hao.y: Acting modestly yet firmly brings rich results.
hao.nom_na: Like a well-planned effort that pays off on several fronts.

hao.dich: Perseverance brings good fortune. Remorse vanishes. Nothing that does not further. No beginning, but an end. Before the change, three days. After the change, three days. Good fortune.
hao.y: A bad start can be turned around with careful timing.
hao.nom_na: Like fixing a project that started badly: plan before and check after, and it ends well.

hao.dich: Penetration under the bed. He loses his property and his axe. Perseverance brings misfortune.
hao.y: Too much searching and giving way loses you your strength.
hao.nom_na: Like being so accommodating you lose your own footing.

que_tu.dich: The Joyous. Success. Perseverance is favourable.

dai_tuong.dich: Lakes resting one on the other: the image of the joyous; the noble person joins with friends for discussion and practice.

58.nom_na: Image: two lakes linked together — refreshing each other. In plain terms: like a cheerful team or good friends learning together: shared joy works, as long as it is sincere, not flattery.

thoan.dich: The joyous means pleasure. Firm in the centre and yielding outside, joy furthers through perseverance; so it accords with heaven and responds to people. When joy goes before the people, they forget their toil; when joy meets difficulty, the people forget even their fear of death. Great is the power of joy, how it encourages the people!

hao.dich: Contented joyousness. Good fortune.
hao.y: Calm, inner joy brings good fortune.
hao.nom_na: Like being content without needing more: good.

hao.dich: Sincere joyousness. Good fortune. Remorse disappears.
hao.y: Sincere joy removes regret.
hao.nom_na: Like genuine happiness with others: good.

hao.dich: Coming joyousness. Misfortune.
hao.y: Chasing pleasure from outside brings trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like seeking fun to escape: it backfires.

hao.dich: Joyousness that is weighed is not at peace. After ridding himself of mistakes a person has joy.
hao.y: Weighing different pleasures; choose the right one.
hao.nom_na: Like being torn between temptations: choosing well brings real joy.

hao.dich: Sincerity towards disintegrating influences is dangerous.
hao.y: Trusting the wrong people is dangerous.
hao.nom_na: Like trusting a flatterer: risky.

hao.dich: Seductive joyousness.
hao.y: Being drawn along by pleasure.
hao.nom_na: Like getting carried away by temptation.

que_tu.dich: Dispersion. Success. The king approaches his temple. It furthers one to cross the great water. Perseverance furthers.

dai_tuong.dich: The wind drives over the water: the image of dispersion; the kings of old sacrificed to the Lord and built temples.

59.nom_na: Image: wind blowing over water — breaking up the ice, scattering what was stuck. In plain terms: like a team or family drifting apart: melt the rigidity and bring people back together around shared values.

thoan.dich: Dispersion brings success. The firm comes and is not exhausted; the yielding gains its place outside and joins those above. The king approaches his temple: the king is in the centre. It furthers to cross the great water: riding on wood brings achievement.

hao.dich: He brings help with the strength of a horse. Good fortune.
hao.y: Act fast at the first sign of scattering.
hao.nom_na: Like stepping in quickly when a team starts to drift: good.

hao.dich: At the dispersion he hurries to that which supports him. Remorse disappears.
hao.y: Run to what gives you stability.
hao.nom_na: Like returning to your support system when things fall apart.

hao.dich: He dissolves his self. No remorse.
hao.y: Letting go of ego brings no regret.
hao.nom_na: Like putting your own interests aside for the group: no regret.

hao.dich: He dissolves his bond with his group. Supreme good fortune. Dispersion leads in turn to accumulation. This is something that ordinary people do not think of.
hao.y: Leaving narrow cliques leads to a bigger union.
hao.nom_na: Like breaking out of a small circle to build a bigger community.

hao.dich: His loud cries are as dissolving as sweat. Dispersion! A king abides without blame.
hao.y: A clear call from a leader brings people together.
hao.nom_na: Like a leader's clear message that rallies everyone.

hao.dich: He dissolves his blood. Departing, keeping at a distance, going out, is without blame.
hao.y: Get yourself and others out of harm's way.
hao.nom_na: Like leaving a dangerous situation in time: no blame.

que_tu.dich: Limitation. Success. Galling limitation must not be persevered in.

dai_tuong.dich: Water over the lake: the image of limitation; the noble person creates number and measure, and examines the nature of virtue and correct conduct.

60.nom_na: Image: a lake holding just as much water as it can — anything more spills over. In plain terms: like a budget or a schedule: set sensible limits, not too loose and not so harsh that you cannot keep them.

thoan.dich: Limitation brings success: the firm and the yielding are divided and the firm holds the centre. Galling limitation must not be persevered in: its way comes to an end. Joyful in going through danger, limiting oneself in the right place, central and correct, one gets through. Heaven and earth have their limits and the four seasons are completed. Through limits and measures, wealth is not wasted and the people are not harmed.

hao.dich: Not going out of the door and the courtyard is without blame.
hao.y: Holding back at the right time is wise.
hao.nom_na: Like staying home when it is not time to go out: no blame.

hao.dich: Not going out of the gate and the courtyard brings misfortune.
hao.y: Holding back when it is time to act is a mistake.
hao.nom_na: Like missing an opportunity by being too cautious.

hao.dich: He who knows no limitation will have cause to lament. No blame.
hao.y: Lack of limits brings regret; learn from it.
hao.nom_na: Like overspending and then regretting it: learn and adjust.

hao.dich: Contented limitation. Success.
hao.y: Limits accepted calmly work well.
hao.nom_na: Like a budget you are happy with: success.

hao.dich: Sweet limitation brings good fortune. Going brings esteem.
hao.y: Limits set with care and kindness win respect.
hao.nom_na: Like a leader who sets fair rules and follows them first: respected.

hao.dich: Galling limitation. Perseverance brings misfortune. Remorse disappears.
hao.y: Too harsh limits backfire, though sometimes needed.
hao.nom_na: Like a strict diet that cannot be kept up: ease off.

que_tu.dich: Inner Truth. Pigs and fishes. Good fortune. It furthers one to cross the great water. Perseverance furthers.

dai_tuong.dich: Wind over the lake: the image of inner truth; the noble person discusses criminal cases in order to delay executions.

61.nom_na: Image: wind moving over the lake — stirring it from within. In plain terms: like trust built on keeping your word: real sincerity moves even the hardest people.

thoan.dich: Inner truth: the yielding is within and the firm holds the centre. Joyful and gentle — sincerity that transforms the country. Pigs and fishes, good fortune: trust reaches even pigs and fishes. It furthers to cross the great water: riding in a hollow wooden boat. Inner truth furthers through perseverance: it responds to heaven.

hao.dich: Being prepared brings good fortune. If there are secret designs, it is disquieting.
hao.y: Inner calm and trust bring good fortune; hidden agendas do not.
hao.nom_na: Like trusting your own judgement without scheming: good.

hao.dich: A crane calling in the shade. Its young answers it. I have a good goblet. I will share it with you.
hao.y: Sincerity calls out and is answered.
hao.nom_na: Like a heartfelt message that finds a warm reply.

hao.dich: He finds a comrade. Now he beats the drum, now he stops. Now he sobs, now he sings.
hao.y: Depending on others, your mood swings.
hao.nom_na: Like letting someone else's moods control yours.

hao.dich: The moon nearly at the full. The team horse goes astray. No blame.
hao.y: Letting go of a partner to stay on the right path.
hao.nom_na: Like parting ways to stay true to what is right: no blame.

hao.dich: He possesses truth, which links together. No blame.
hao.y: Sincerity that binds people together.
hao.nom_na: Like a leader whose honesty holds the team together.

hao.dich: Cockcrow penetrating to heaven. Perseverance brings misfortune.
hao.y: Empty words that claim too much bring trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like big promises with nothing behind them.

que_tu.dich: Preponderance of the Small. Success. Perseverance furthers. Small things may be done; great things should not be done. The flying bird brings the message: it is not well to strive upward, it is well to remain below. Great good fortune.

dai_tuong.dich: Thunder on the mountain: the image of preponderance of the small; in conduct the noble person gives preponderance to reverence, in mourning to grief, in expenditure to thrift.

62.nom_na: Image: thunder over the mountain — a voice that should stay low. In plain terms: like a time for careful small steps: do the small things thoroughly, stay modest, and take no big risks.

thoan.dich: Preponderance of the small: the small are in excess and there is success. Excess that furthers through perseverance moves with the time. The yielding holds the centre, so small things bring good fortune. The firm has lost its place and is not central, so great things should not be done. There is the image of a flying bird: it brings the message that it is not well to strive upward, it is well to stay below — great good fortune; going up is against the grain, going down goes with it.

hao.dich: The bird meets with misfortune through flying.
hao.y: Rising too fast brings trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like trying to leap ahead too soon: it goes wrong.

hao.dich: She passes by her ancestor and meets her ancestress. He does not reach his prince and meets the official. No blame.
hao.y: Going through the proper channel rather than straight to the top.
hao.nom_na: Like working through your manager instead of over their head: no blame.

hao.dich: If one is not extremely careful, somebody may come up from behind and strike him. Misfortune.
hao.y: Not being careful enough leaves you open to harm.
hao.nom_na: Like being careless with your guard down: you may be caught out.

hao.dich: No blame. He meets him without passing by. Going brings danger. One must be on guard. Do not act. Be constantly persevering.
hao.y: Do not force things; stay alert.
hao.nom_na: Like holding back and keeping watch: safe.

hao.dich: Dense clouds, no rain from our western territory. The prince shoots and hits him who is in the cave.
hao.y: Getting help from those who are hidden or overlooked.
hao.nom_na: Like finding the right person in an unexpected place.

hao.dich: He passes him by, not meeting him. The flying bird leaves him. Misfortune. This means bad luck and injury.
hao.y: Overreaching without knowing your limits brings trouble.
hao.nom_na: Like flying too high and too far: you lose your way.

que_tu.dich: After Completion. Success in small matters. Perseverance furthers. At the beginning good fortune, at the end disorder.

dai_tuong.dich: Water over fire: the image of the condition after completion; the noble person takes thought of misfortune and arms themselves against it in advance.

63.nom_na: Image: water over fire — everything in its place, but the balance is delicate. In plain terms: like right after a big success: protect what you have achieved and guard against things slipping.

thoan.dich: After completion, success: the small succeed. Perseverance furthers: the firm and the yielding are correct and in their proper places. At the beginning good fortune: the yielding holds the centre. At the end, stopping brings disorder: its way comes to an end.

hao.dich: He brakes his wheels. He gets his tail in the water. No blame.
hao.y: Hold back a little after success.
hao.nom_na: Like slowing down after a win: no blame.

hao.dich: The woman loses the curtain of her carriage. Do not run after it; on the seventh day you will get it.
hao.y: What is lost will return; do not chase it.
hao.nom_na: Like losing something small after success: let it be, it comes back.

hao.dich: The Illustrious Ancestor disciplines the Devil's Country. After three years he conquers it. Inferior people must not be employed.
hao.y: A long effort; use only the right people.
hao.nom_na: Like a long hard project: choose your team carefully.

hao.dich: The finest clothes turn to rags. Be careful all day long.
hao.y: Stay watchful; things can wear out.
hao.nom_na: Like checking for leaks after finishing a big job.

hao.dich: The neighbour in the east who slaughters an ox does not attain as much real happiness as the neighbour in the west with his small offering.
hao.y: Sincerity matters more than display.
hao.nom_na: Like a small, heartfelt gesture that means more than a lavish one.

hao.dich: He gets his head in the water. Danger.
hao.y: Going too far after success is dangerous.
hao.nom_na: Like celebrating too much and losing track: risky.

que_tu.dich: Before Completion. Success. But if the little fox, after nearly completing the crossing, gets his tail in the water, there is nothing that would further.

dai_tuong.dich: Fire over water: the image of the condition before transition; the noble person is careful in the differentiation of things, so that each finds its place.

64.nom_na: Image: fire above water — two forces not yet working together. In plain terms: like a project in its last stretch: it is not finished yet; stay careful, see things clearly, and put each thing in its place.

thoan.dich: Before completion, success: the yielding holds the centre. The little fox nearly completes the crossing: it has not yet got out of the middle. It gets its tail in the water and nothing furthers: it does not continue to the end. Though the lines are not in their proper places, the firm and the yielding respond to each other.

hao.dich: He gets his tail in the water. Humiliating.
hao.y: Rushing at the start leads to embarrassment.
hao.nom_na: Like starting before you are ready: you trip up.

hao.dich: He brakes his wheels. Perseverance brings good fortune.
hao.y: Hold back and wait; it is good.
hao.nom_na: Like pacing yourself: good.

hao.dich: Before completion, attack brings misfortune. It furthers one to cross the great water.
hao.y: Not ready to force things, but a bold move with help can work.
hao.nom_na: Like not being able to finish alone: get help and then go for it.

hao.dich: Perseverance brings good fortune. Remorse disappears. Shock, thus to discipline the Devil's Country. For three years, great realms are awarded.
hao.y: Sustained effort brings reward.
hao.nom_na: Like a long push that finally pays off.

hao.dich: Perseverance brings good fortune. No remorse. The light of the noble person is true. Good fortune.
hao.y: Sincere leadership shines.
hao.nom_na: Like a leader whose honesty is clear to all: good fortune.

hao.dich: There is drinking of wine in genuine confidence. No blame. But if one wets one's head, one loses it, in truth.
hao.y: Celebrate with trust, but do not overdo it.
hao.nom_na: Like celebrating the end of a project: enjoy, but do not lose your head.
